textAr: الرضا بالقضاء والقدر يربح القلب ويطرد الهم والغم
textFr: Le contentement face au destin apaise le cœur et chasse les soucis et la tristesse.
textEn: Contentment with the divine decree wins the heart and drives away worries and grief.
sourceEn: Salaf

textAr: الزَّهَادَةُ فِي الدُّنْيَا رَاحَةُ الْقَلْبِ وَالْجَسَدِ
textFr: L'ascèse dans ce monde est une source de repos pour le cœur et le corps.
textEn: Asceticism in this world is a comfort for the heart and the body.
sourceAr: عمر بن الخطاب رضي الله عنه
sourceEn: ‘Umar ibn al-Khattâb (may Allah be pleased with him)

textAr: أَدْرَكْنَا خَيْرَ عَيْشِنَا بِالصَّبْرِ
textFr: Nous avons atteint la meilleure vie par la patience.
textEn: We have attained the best of our life through patience.
sourceAr: عمر بن الخطاب رضي الله عنه
sourceEn: ‘Umar ibn al-Khattâb (may Allah be pleased with him)

textAr: إِنَّ الصَّبْرَ مِنَ الْإِيمَانِ بِمَنْزِلَةِ الرَّأْسِ مِنَ الْجَسَدِ
textFr: La patience est à la foi ce que la tête est au corps.
textEn: Patience is to faith as the head is to the body.
sourceAr: علي بن أبي طالب رضي الله عنه
sourceEn: ‘Alî ibn Abî Tâlib (may Allah be pleased with him)

textAr: مَا أَنْعَمَ اللَّهُ عَلَى عَبْدٍ نِعْمَةً فَانْتَزَعَهَا مِنْهُ، فَعَاضَهُ مَكَانَهَا الصَّبْرَ، إِلَّا كَانَ مَا عَوَّضَهُ خَيْرًا مِمَّا انْتَزَعَ مِنْهُ
textFr: Allah n'accorde une grâce à un serviteur puis ne la lui retire, pour le compenser par la patience, sans que ce qu'Il lui donne en compensation ne soit meilleur que ce qu'Il lui a retiré.
textEn: Allah does not bestow a favor upon a servant and then take it away, compensating him with patience, without that compensation being better than what was taken.
sourceAr: عمر بن عبد العزيز رحمه الله
sourceEn: ‘Umar ibn ‘Abd al-‘Azîz (may Allah have mercy on him)

textAr: لَيْسَ الزُّهْدُ بِأَكْلِ الْغَلِيظِ، وَلَبْسِ الْخَشِنِ، وَلَكِنَّهُ قِصَرُ الْأَمَلِ، وَارْتِقَابُ الْمَوْتِ
textFr: L'ascèse ne consiste pas à manger grossièrement ou à s'habiller de façon rugueuse, mais elle consiste à avoir des aspirations courtes et à attendre la mort.
textEn: Asceticism is not about eating coarse food or wearing rough clothes, but it is about having short hopes and awaiting death.
sourceEn: Sufyân ath-Thawrî (may Allah have mercy on him)

textAr: مَنْ زَهِدَ فِي الدُّنْيَا مَلَكَهَا، وَمَنْ رَغِبَ فِيهَا عَبَدَهَا
textFr: Celui qui se détache de ce monde en devient le maître, et celui qui y aspire en devient l'esclave.
textEn: Whoever renounces this world masters it, and whoever desires it becomes its slave.
sourceEn: Sufyân ath-Thawrî (may Allah have mercy on him)

textAr: مَنْ أَحَبَّ الدُّنْيَا وَسَرَّتْهُ، خَرَجَ حُبُّ الْآخِرَةِ مِنْ قَلْبِهِ
textFr: Celui qui aime ce monde et en est satisfait, l'amour de l'au-delà sort de son cœur.
textEn: Whoever loves this world and is pleased with it, the love of the Hereafter leaves his heart.
sourceEn: Al-Hasan al-Basrî (may Allah have mercy on him)

textAr: إِيَّاكَ وَالشُّهْرَةَ، فَمَا أَتَيْتُ أَحَدًا إِلَّا وَقَدْ نَهَانِي عَنِ الشُّهْرَةِ
textFr: Méfie-toi de la notoriété, car je n'ai rencontré personne qui ne m'ait interdit la notoriété.
textEn: Beware of fame, for I have never met anyone who did not forbid me from fame.
sourceEn: Sufyân ath-Thawrî (may Allah have mercy on him)

textAr: ذِكْرُ النَّاسِ دَاءٌ، وَذِكْرُ اللَّهِ شِفَاءٌ
textFr: Parler des gens est une maladie, et se souvenir d'Allah est un remède.
textEn: Mentioning people is a disease, and remembering Allah is a cure.
sourceEn: Al-Fudayl ibn ‘Iyâd (may Allah have mercy on him)

textAr: كَلاَمُ الْمُؤْمِنِ حِكْمَةٌ، وَصَمْتُهُ تَفَكُّرٌ، وَنَظَرُهُ عِبْرَةٌ، وَعَمَلُهُ بِرٌّ
textFr: La parole du croyant est une sagesse, son silence est une méditation, son regard est une leçon et son œuvre est une piété.
textEn: The speech of the believer is wisdom, his silence is contemplation, his gaze is a lesson, and his deed is righteousness.
sourceEn: Al-Fudayl ibn ‘Iyâd (may Allah have mercy on him)

textAr: إِنَّمَا يَهَابُكَ الْخَلْقُ عَلَى قَدْرِ هَيْبَتِكَ لِلَّهِ
textFr: Les créatures ne te craignent qu'à proportion de ta crainte d'Allah.
textEn: People only fear you to the extent of your fear of Allah.
sourceEn: Al-Fudayl ibn ‘Iyâd (may Allah have mercy on him)

textAr: بِحَسْبِ الْمَرْءِ مِنَ الْكَذِبِ أَنْ يُحَدِّثَ بِكُلِّ مَا سَمِعَ
textFr: Il suffit à l'homme comme mensonge de rapporter tout ce qu'il a entendu.
textEn: It is enough for a man to be a liar that he narrates everything he hears.
sourceAr: عمر بن الخطاب رضي الله عنه
sourceEn: ‘Umar ibn al-Khattâb (may Allah be pleased with him)

textAr: مَنْ كَثُرَ كَلاَمُهُ كَثُرَ سَقَطُهُ
textFr: Celui dont les paroles sont nombreuses, ses erreurs sont nombreuses.
textEn: Whoever speaks a lot, his mistakes are many.
sourceAr: عمر بن الخطاب رضي الله عنه
sourceEn: ‘Umar ibn al-Khattâb (may Allah be pleased with him)

textAr: مَنْ كَثُرَ ضَحِكُهُ قَلَّتْ هَيْبَتُهُ
textFr: Celui qui rit beaucoup, sa dignité diminue.
textEn: Whoever laughs a lot, his respectability diminishes.
sourceAr: عمر بن الخطاب رضي الله عنه
sourceEn: ‘Umar ibn al-Khattâb (may Allah be pleased with him)

textAr: الصَّبْرُ نِصْفُ الْإِيمَانِ
textFr: La patience est la moitié de la foi.
textEn: Patience is half of faith.
sourceAr: عبد الله بن مسعود رضي الله عنه
sourceEn: ‘Abd Allâh ibn Mas‘ûd (may Allah be pleased with him)

textAr: الصَّبْرُ كَنْزٌ مِنْ كُنُوزِ الْخَيْرِ، لَا يُعْطِيهِ اللَّهُ إِلَّا لِعَبْدٍ كَرِيمٍ عِنْدَهُ
textFr: La patience est un trésor parmi les trésors du bien qu'Allah n'accorde qu'à un serviteur qui est noble auprès de Lui.
textEn: Patience is a treasure among the treasures of good that Allah only gives to a servant who is noble in His sight.
sourceEn: Al-Hasan al-Basrî (may Allah have mercy on him)

textAr: إِنَّ الْمُؤْمِنَ يُصْبِحُ حَزِينًا وَيُمْسِي حَزِينًا، وَلَا يَسَعُهُ غَيْرُ ذَلِكَ، لِأَنَّهُ بَيْنَ خَوْفٍ وَرَجَاءٍ
textFr: Le croyant se lève triste et se couche triste, et il ne peut en être autrement, car il est entre la crainte et l'espoir.
textEn: The believer wakes up sad and goes to bed sad, and he cannot be otherwise, for he is between fear and hope.
sourceEn: Al-Hasan al-Basrî (may Allah have mercy on him)

textAr: مَنْ زَهِدَ فِي الدُّنْيَا هَانَتْ عَلَيْهِ الْمُصِيبَاتُ
textFr: Celui qui se détache de ce monde, les épreuves lui deviennent faciles.
textEn: Whoever renounces this world, calamities become easy for him.
sourceAr: علي بن أبي طالب رضي الله عنه
sourceEn: ‘Alî ibn Abî Tâlib (may Allah be pleased with him)

textAr: لَا يَكُنْ حُبُّكَ كَلَفًا، وَلَا بُغْضُكَ تَلَفًا
textFr: Que ton amour ne soit pas une obsession et que ta haine ne soit pas une destruction.
textEn: Let not your love be an obsession, nor your hate a destruction.

textFr: Améliore ta vie intérieure, Allah améliorera ta vie extérieure. Répare ce qui est entre toi et Allah, Il réparera ce qui est entre toi et les gens.
textEn: Improve your private life, Allah will improve your public life. Fix what is between you and Allah, He will fix what is between you and the people.
sourceEn: Sufyân ath-Thawrî (may Allah have mercy on him)

textFr: Si tu aimes un homme pour Allah puis qu'il innove dans l'Islam, ne le hais pas, car tu ne l'as jamais aimé pour Allah.
textEn: If you love a man for Allah and then he innovates in Islam, do not hate him, for you never loved him for Allah.
sourceEn: Sufyân ath-Thawrî (may Allah have mercy on him)

textAr: الْقَنَاعَةُ بِمَا رَزَقَكَ اللَّهُ تَكُنْ غَنِيًّا، وَالتَّوَكُّلُ عَلَى اللَّهِ يَكُنْ قَوِيًّا
textFr: Sois satisfait de ce qu'Allah t'a attribué et tu seras riche. Place ta confiance en Allah et tu seras fort.
textEn: Be content with what Allah has provided you and you will be rich. Put your trust in Allah and you will be strong.
sourceEn: Sufyân ath-Thawrî (may Allah have mercy on him)

textFr: Ne restez pas inactifs, car la mort vous cherche.
textEn: Do not sit idle, for indeed Death is seeking you.
sourceEn: Al-Hasan al-Basrî (may Allah have mercy on him)

textAr: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّكَ تَرَى قُلُوبَنَا مَمْلُوءَةً بِالشِّرْكِ وَالْكِبْرِ وَالنِّفَاقِ وَالرِّيَاءِ وَالسُّمْعَةِ وَالشَّكِّ فِي دِينِكَ
textFr: Ô Allah, Tu vois nos cœurs remplis d'association, d'orgueil, d'hypocrisie, d'ostentation, de recherche de réputation et de doute dans Ta religion.
textEn: O Allah, You see our hearts full of idolatry, pride, hypocrisy, showing-off, reputation, and doubt in Your religion.
sourceEn: Al-Hasan al-Basrî (may Allah have mercy on him)

textAr: مَنْ عَامَلَ النَّاسَ فَلَمْ يَظْلِمْهُمْ، وَحَدَّثَهُمْ فَلَمْ يَكْذِبْهُمْ، وَوَعَدَهُمْ فَلَمْ يُخْلِفْهُمْ، فَذَلِكَ مِمَّنْ كَمُلَتْ مُرُوءَتُهُ
textFr: Celui qui traite les gens sans les opprimer, leur parle sans leur mentir et leur promet sans manquer à sa promesse, celui-là a une virilité parfaite.
textEn: Whoever treats people without oppressing them, speaks to them without lying, and promises them without breaking his promise, that person has perfect manhood.
sourceAr: عبد الله بن مسعود رضي الله عنه
sourceEn: ‘Abd Allâh ibn Mas‘ûd (may Allah be pleased with him)

textAr: إِيَّاكَ وَمُجَالَسَةَ أَهْلِ الْأَهْوَاءِ، فَإِنَّهُمْ مَرْضَى الْقُلُوبِ
textFr: Méfie-toi de la fréquentation des gens de passions, car ils ont les cœurs malades.
textEn: Beware of sitting with the people of desires, for they have diseased hearts.
sourceAr: عبد الله بن مسعود رضي الله عنه
sourceEn: ‘Abd Allâh ibn Mas‘ûd (may Allah be pleased with him)

textAr: مَنْ جَاهَدَ نَفْسَهُ فِي طَاعَةِ اللَّهِ، مَلَكَهَا، وَمَنْ أَهْمَلَهَا، هَلَكَتْ
textFr: Celui qui lutte contre son âme dans l'obéissance à Allah en devient le maître, et celui qui la néglige périt.
textEn: Whoever strives against his soul in obedience to Allah masters it, and whoever neglects it perishes.
sourceAr: علي بن أبي طالب رضي الله عنه
sourceEn: ‘Alî ibn Abî Tâlib (may Allah be pleased with him)

textAr: خَيْرُ النَّاسِ مَنْ نَفَعَ النَّاسَ، وَشَرُّهُمْ مَنْ ضَرَّ النَّاسَ
textFr: Le meilleur des gens est celui qui est utile aux gens, et le pire est celui qui leur nuit.
textEn: The best of people is the one who benefits people, and the worst is the one who harms them.
sourceAr: عبد الله بن مسعود رضي الله عنه
sourceEn: ‘Abd Allâh ibn Mas‘ûd (may Allah be pleased with him)

textAr: السَّكِينَةُ فِي الْقَلْبِ تَأْتِي مِنَ الْيَقِينِ، وَالْيَقِينُ يَأْتِي مِنَ التَّوَكُّلِ عَلَى اللَّهِ
textFr: La sérénité du cœur vient de la certitude, et la certitude vient de la confiance en Allah.
textEn: Serenity in the heart comes from certainty, and certainty comes from trust in Allah.
sourceEn: Sufyân ath-Thawrî (may Allah have mercy on him)

textAr: الصَّبْرُ عَلَى السُّنَّةِ خَيْرٌ مِنَ الصَّبْرِ عَلَى الْجِرَاحِ
textFr: La patience sur la Sunna est meilleure que la patience sur les blessures.
textEn: Patience upon the Sunnah is better than patience upon wounds.
sourceEn: Sufyân ath-Thawrî (may Allah have mercy on him)

textAr: الْعِلْمُ بِاللَّهِ تَأْدِيبٌ، وَالْعِلْمُ بِالدُّنْيَا تَعْذِيبٌ
textFr: La connaissance d'Allah est une éducation, et la connaissance du monde est un châtiment.
textEn: Knowledge of Allah is discipline, and knowledge of this world is torment.
sourceEn: Al-Hasan al-Basrî (may Allah have mercy on him)

textAr: مَنْ عَرَفَ اللَّهَ هَانَتْ عَلَيْهِ الْمُصِيبَاتُ
textFr: Celui qui connaît Allah, les épreuves lui deviennent légères.
textEn: Whoever knows Allah, calamities become easy for him.
sourceEn: Al-Hasan al-Basrî (may Allah have mercy on him)

textAr: أَكْثِرُوا ذِكْرَ اللَّهِ فِي الدُّنْيَا فَلَا تَنْسَوْهُ فِي الْقُبُورِ
textFr: Invoquez beaucoup Allah dans ce monde, afin de ne pas L'oublier dans les tombes.
textEn: Remember Allah often in this world, so that you do not forget Him in the graves.
sourceEn: Al-Hasan al-Basrî (may Allah have mercy on him)

textAr: إِذَا أَرَادَ اللَّهُ بِعَبْدٍ خَيْرًا فَتَحَ لَهُ بَابَ الْعَمَلِ، وَأَغْلَقَ عَنْهُ بَابَ الْجَدَلِ
textFr: Si Allah veut du bien à un serviteur, Il lui ouvre la porte de l'action et Lui ferme la porte de la dispute.
textEn: If Allah wants good for a servant, He opens for him the door of action and closes the door of argumentation.
sourceEn: Sufyân ath-Thawrî (may Allah have mercy on him)

textAr: الْقَلْبُ إِذَا اشْتَغَلَ بِالدُّنْيَا فَاتَتْهُ الْآخِرَةُ
textFr: Si le cœur s'occupe de ce monde, l'au-delà lui échappe.
textEn: If the heart is occupied with this world, the Hereafter escapes it.
sourceEn: Al-Hasan al-Basrî (may Allah have mercy on him)

textAr: لَا تَنْظُرْ إِلَى صِغَرِ الْخَطِيئَةِ، وَلَكِنِ انْظُرْ إِلَى عَظَمَةِ مَنْ عَصَيْتَ
textFr: Ne regarde pas la petitesse du péché, mais regarde la grandeur de Celui que tu désobéis.
textEn: Do not look at the smallness of the sin, but look at the greatness of the One you disobey.
sourceAr: علي بن أبي طالب رضي الله عنه
sourceEn: ‘Alî ibn Abî Tâlib (may Allah be pleased with him)

textAr: عَجِبْتُ لِمَنْ يَبْنِي دَارًا فِي الدُّنْيَا وَيَتْرُكُ دَارًا فِي الْآخِرَةِ
textFr: Je m'étonne de celui qui construit une maison dans ce monde et abandonne sa maison dans l'au-delà.
textEn: I am amazed at the one who builds a house in this world and abandons his house in the Hereafter.
sourceEn: Al-Hasan al-Basrî (may Allah have mercy on him)

textAr: إِنَّ اللَّهَ إِذَا أَحَبَّ عَبْدًا ابْتَلَاهُ، وَإِذَا ابْتَلَاهُ رَزَقَهُ الصَّبْرَ، وَإِذَا رَزَقَهُ الصَّبْرَ اسْتَوْجَبَ الشُّكْرَ
textFr: Lorsqu'Allah aime un serviteur, Il l'éprouve ; et lorsqu'Il l'éprouve, Il lui accorde la patience ; et lorsqu'Il lui accorde la patience, Il le rend digne de reconnaissance.
textEn: When Allah loves a servant, He tests him; and when He tests him, He grants him patience; and when He grants him patience, He makes him worthy of gratitude.
sourceEn: Sufyân ath-Thawrî (may Allah have mercy on him)

textEn: Serenity in the heart comes from certainty, and certainty comes from trust in Allah.

textAr: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّكَ تَرَى قُلُوبَنَا مَمْلُوءَةً بِالشِّرْكِ وَالْكِبْرِ وَالنِّفَاقِ وَالرِّيَاءِ وَالسُّمْعَةِ وَالشَّكِّ فِي دِينِكَ
textFr: Ô Allah, Tu vois nos cœurs remplis d'association, d'orgueil, d'hypocrisie, d'ostentation, de recherche de réputation et de doute dans Ta religion.
textEn: O Allah, You see our hearts full of idolatry, pride, hypocrisy, showing-off, reputation, and doubt in Your religion.
sourceEn: Al-Hasan al-Basrî (may Allah have mercy on him)

textAr: لَا تَجْلِسُوا فَرَاغًا، فَإِنَّ الْمَوْتَ يَطْلُبُكُمْ
textFr: Ne restez pas inactifs, car la mort vous cherche.
textEn: Do not sit idle, for indeed death is seeking you.
sourceEn: Al-Hasan al-Basrî (may Allah have mercy on him)

textAr: الدُّنْيَا دَارُ عُبُورٍ، وَالْآخِرَةُ دَارُ قَرَارٍ، فَخُذُوا مِنْ دَارِ الْعُبُورِ لِدَارِ الْقَرَارِ
textFr: Ce monde est une demeure de passage, et l'au-delà est une demeure d'éternité. Prenez donc de la demeure de passage pour la demeure d'éternité.
textEn: This world is a house of passage, and the Hereafter is a house of eternity. So take from the house of passage for the house of eternity.
sourceEn: Al-Hasan al-Basrî (may Allah have mercy on him)

textAr: إِنَّمَا الدُّنْيَا ثَلَاثَةُ أَيَّامٍ: أَمْسِ فَقَدْ مَضَى، وَغَدٍ فَلَعَلَّكَ لَا تُدْرِكُهُ، وَالْيَوْمِ فَلَكَ فَاعْمَلْ
textFr: La vie de ce monde n'est que de trois jours : hier est passé, demain tu ne l'atteindras peut-être pas, et aujourd'hui est pour toi, agis donc.
textEn: The life of this world is only three days: yesterday has passed, tomorrow you may not reach, and today is for you, so act.
sourceEn: Al-Hasan al-Basrî (may Allah have mercy on him)

textAr: مَنْ أَحَبَّ الْآخِرَةَ تَعَبَ فِي الدُّنْيَا، وَمَنْ أَحَبَّ الدُّنْيَا تَعِبَ فِي الْآخِرَةِ
textFr: Celui qui aime l'au-delà peine dans ce monde, et celui qui aime ce monde peine dans l'au-delà.
textEn: Whoever loves the Hereafter toils in this world, and whoever loves this world toils in the Hereafter.
sourceAr: علي بن أبي طالب رضي الله عنه
sourceEn: ‘Alî ibn Abî Tâlib (may Allah be pleased with him)

textAr: لَيْسَ الْغِنَى عَنْ كَثْرَةِ الْعَرَضِ، وَلَكِنَّ الْغِنَى غِنَى النَّفْسِ
textFr: La richesse ne consiste pas dans l'abondance des biens, mais la richesse est la richesse de l'âme.
textEn: Wealth is not in having many possessions, but wealth is the richness of the soul.
sourceAr: عمر بن الخطاب رضي الله عنه
sourceEn: ‘Umar ibn al-Khattâb (may Allah be pleased with him)

textAr: إِذَا اسْتَيْقَنْتَ رَبَّكَ فَلَا تَهْتَمَّ بِالرِّزْقِ
textFr: Si tu es certain de ton Seigneur, ne t'inquiète pas pour la subsistance.
textEn: If you are certain of your Lord, do not worry about provision.
sourceEn: Sufyân ath-Thawrî (may Allah have mercy on him)

textAr: مَنْ أَصْلَحَ سَرِيرَتَهُ، أَصْلَحَ اللَّهُ عَلَانِيَتَهُ
textFr: Celui qui améliore sa vie intérieure, Allah améliore sa vie extérieure.
textEn: Whoever improves his inner self, Allah improves his outer self.
sourceEn: Sufyân ath-Thawrî (may Allah have mercy on him)

textAr: إِيَّاكَ وَالْغَفْلَةَ، فَإِنَّهَا تَمْنَعُكَ مِنْ ذِكْرِ اللَّهِ
textFr: Méfie-toi de l'insouciance, car elle t'empêche de te souvenir d'Allah.
textEn: Beware of heedlessness, for it prevents you from remembering Allah.
sourceAr: عبد الله بن مسعود رضي الله عنه
sourceEn: ‘Abd Allâh ibn Mas‘ûd (may Allah be pleased with him)

textAr: الْعِبَادَةُ سَبْعُونَ جُزْءًا، أَفْضَلُهَا طَلَبُ الْحَلَالِ
textFr: L'adoration est composée de soixante-dix parts, la meilleure est la recherche du licite.
textEn: Worship is composed of seventy parts, the best of which is seeking the lawful.
sourceEn: Sufyân ath-Thawrî (may Allah have mercy on him)

textAr: مَنْ عَرَفَ نَفْسَهُ عَرَفَ رَبَّهُ
textFr: Celui qui connaît son âme connaît son Seigneur.
textEn: Whoever knows his soul knows his Lord.
sourceAr: علي بن أبي طالب رضي الله عنه
sourceEn: ‘Alî ibn Abî Tâlib (may Allah be pleased with him)

textAr: الصَّمْتُ سَلَامَةٌ، وَالْعَمَلُ عِبَادَةٌ، وَالْعِلْمُ حَيَاةٌ
textFr: Le silence est sécurité, l'action est adoration, et la science est vie.
textEn: Silence is safety, action is worship, and knowledge is life.
sourceAr: عمر بن الخطاب رضي الله عنه
sourceEn: ‘Umar ibn al-Khattâb (may Allah be pleased with him)

textAr: لَا تَحْسَبَنَّ الْخَطِيئَةَ صَغِيرَةً، فَإِنَّهَا تَزِيدُ حَتَّى تَكُونَ كَبِيرَةً
textFr: Ne pense pas que le péché soit petit, car il augmente jusqu'à devenir grand.
textEn: Do not think that a sin is small, for it increases until it becomes great.
sourceEn: Sufyân ath-Thawrî (may Allah have mercy on him)

textAr: إِنَّمَا يَهَابُكَ النَّاسُ عَلَى قَدْرِ هَيْبَتِكَ لِلَّهِ
textFr: Les gens ne te craignent qu'à proportion de ta crainte d'Allah.
textEn: People only fear you to the extent of your fear of Allah.
sourceEn: Al-Fudayl ibn ‘Iyâd (may Allah have mercy on him)

textAr: ذِكْرُ اللَّهِ شِفَاءُ الْقُلُوبِ، وَذِكْرُ النَّاسِ دَاءٌ
textFr: Le rappel d'Allah est un remède pour les cœurs, et le rappel des gens est une maladie.
textEn: The remembrance of Allah is a cure for the hearts, and the remembrance of people is a disease.
sourceEn: Al-Fudayl ibn ‘Iyâd (may Allah have mercy on him)

textAr: كُنْ فِي الدُّنْيَا كَأَنَّكَ غَرِيبٌ أَوْ عَابِرُ سَبِيلٍ
textFr: Sois dans ce monde comme un étranger ou un voyageur de passage.
textEn: Be in this world as if you were a stranger or a passerby.
sourceAr: عبد الله بن عمر رضي الله عنهما
sourceEn: ‘Abd Allâh ibn ‘Umar (may Allah be pleased with them)

textAr: الْمُؤْمِنُ مِسْكِينٌ، وَالْمُؤْمِنُ أُخُو الْمُؤْمِنِ، وَالْمُؤْمِنُ يَأْلَفُ وَيُؤْلَفُ
textFr: Le croyant est humble, le croyant est le frère du croyant, et le croyant est sociable et apprécié.
textEn: The believer is humble, the believer is the brother of the believer, and the believer is sociable and liked.
sourceAr: عبد الله بن مسعود رضي الله عنه
sourceEn: ‘Abd Allâh ibn Mas‘ûd (may Allah be pleased with him)

textAr: مَنْ أَحَبَّ أَنْ يُعْطِيَهُ اللَّهُ الْعِلْمَ وَلَمْ يَعْمَلْ بِهِ، كَانَ كَالْحِمَارِ يَحْمِلُ أَسْفَارًا
textFr: Celui qui aime recevoir la science d'Allah sans agir selon elle, est comme l'âne qui porte des livres.
textEn: Whoever loves to receive knowledge from Allah but does not act upon it, is like a donkey carrying books.
sourceEn: Al-Hasan al-Basrî (may Allah have mercy on him)

textAr: الْإِخْلَاصُ سِرٌّ بَيْنَ اللَّهِ وَبَيْنَ عَبْدِهِ، لَا يَعْلَمُهُ مَلَكٌ فَيَكْتُبَهُ، وَلَا شَيْطَانٌ فَيُفْسِدَهُ
textFr: La sincérité est un secret entre Allah et Son serviteur, qu'aucun ange ne connaît pour l'écrire, ni aucun démon pour le corrompre.
textEn: Sincerity is a secret between Allah and His servant, which no angel knows to write, nor any devil to corrupt.
sourceEn: Sufyân ath-Thawrî (may Allah have mercy on him)

textAr: الْحَيَاءُ رَاحَةُ الْقَلْبِ، وَالْكِبْرُ عَذَابُ النَّفْسِ
textFr: La pudeur est le repos du cœur, et l'orgueil est le châtiment de l'âme.
textEn: Modesty is the rest of the heart, and pride is the torment of the soul.
sourceAr: عمر بن الخطاب رضي الله عنه
sourceEn: ‘Umar ibn al-Khattâb (may Allah be pleased with him)

textAr: لَا تَسُبَّنَّ أَحَدًا، فَإِنَّ السَّبَّ يَرُدُّ عَلَى صَاحِبِهِ
textFr: N'insulte jamais personne, car l'insulte retombe sur son auteur.
textEn: Never insult anyone, for the insult returns to its author.
sourceAr: علي بن أبي طالب رضي الله عنه
sourceEn: ‘Alî ibn Abî Tâlib (may Allah be pleased with him)

textAr: السَّعَادَةُ لَيْسَتْ فِي كَثْرَةِ الْمَالِ، وَلَكِنْ فِي طُمَأْنِينَةِ الْقَلْبِ
textFr: Le bonheur ne réside pas dans l'abondance des biens, mais dans la sérénité du cœur.
textEn: Happiness is not in having much wealth, but in the tranquility of the heart.
sourceAr: عبد الله بن مسعود رضي الله عنه
sourceEn: ‘Abd Allâh ibn Mas‘ûd (may Allah be pleased with him)

textAr: إِذَا رَأَيْتَ الرَّجُلَ يُحِبُّ الذِّكْرَ فَاعْلَمْ أَنَّ اللَّهَ يُحِبُّهُ
textFr: Si tu vois un homme aimer le rappel d'Allah, sache qu'Allah l'aime.
textEn: If you see a man loving the remembrance of Allah, know that Allah loves him.
sourceEn: Al-Hasan al-Basrî (may Allah have mercy on him)

textAr: مَنْ أَحَبَّ الْعُزْلَةَ فَقَدْ سَلِمَ مِنَ النَّاسِ، وَمَنْ سَلِمَ مِنَ النَّاسِ سَلِمَ دِينُهُ
textFr: Celui qui aime la solitude s'est préservé des gens, et celui qui s'est préservé des gens a préservé sa religion.
textEn: Whoever loves solitude has saved himself from people, and whoever saves himself from people has saved his religion.
sourceEn: Sufyân ath-Thawrî (may Allah have mercy on him)

textAr: الْعَمَلُ بِالسُّنَّةِ رَأْسُ الْحِكْمَةِ
textFr: Agir selon la Sunna est la tête de la sagesse.
textEn: Acting upon the Sunnah is the head of wisdom.
sourceEn: Sufyân ath-Thawrî (may Allah have mercy on him)

textAr: خَالِطُوا النَّاسَ بِأَخْلَاقِ الْإِسْلَامِ، وَاعْتَزِلُوا عَنْ أَهْلِ الْبِدَعِ
textFr: Fréquentez les gens avec les caractères de l'Islam, et éloignez-vous des gens de l'innovation.
textEn: Mix with people with the manners of Islam, and keep away from the people of innovation.
sourceAr: عبد الله بن مسعود رضي الله عنه
sourceEn: ‘Abd Allâh ibn Mas‘ûd (may Allah be pleased with him)

textAr: مَنْ كَثُرَ صَمْتُهُ كَثُرَ وَقَارُهُ، وَمَنْ كَثُرَ كَلَامُهُ كَثُرَ سَقَطُهُ
textFr: Celui dont le silence est abondant, sa dignité est grande ; et celui dont les paroles sont nombreuses, ses erreurs sont nombreuses.
textEn: Whoever's silence is abundant, his dignity is great; and whoever's speech is abundant, his mistakes are many.
sourceAr: عمر بن الخطاب رضي الله عنه
sourceEn: ‘Umar ibn al-Khattâb (may Allah be pleased with him)

textAr: الْعِلْمُ يَنْقُصُ بِالتَّرْكِ، وَيَزِيدُ بِالْعَمَلِ
textFr: La science diminue par l'abandon et augmente par la pratique.
textEn: Knowledge decreases by abandonment and increases by practice.
sourceEn: Sufyân ath-Thawrî (may Allah have mercy on him)

textAr: إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُحِبُّ الْعَبْدَ التَّقِيَّ الْغَنِيَّ الْخَفِيَّ
textFr: Allah aime le serviteur pieux, riche (de cœur) et discret.
textEn: Allah loves the pious servant, rich (of heart) and discreet.
sourceEn: Al-Fudayl ibn ‘Iyâd (may Allah have mercy on him)

textAr: لَا تَرْكَنُوا إِلَى الدُّنْيَا، فَإِنَّهَا لَيْسَتْ بِدَارِ قَرَارٍ
textFr: Ne vous appuyez pas sur ce monde, car il n'est pas une demeure d'éternité.
textEn: Do not rely on this world, for it is not a place of permanence.
sourceAr: علي بن أبي طالب رضي الله عنه
sourceEn: ‘Alî ibn Abî Tâlib (may Allah be pleased with him)

textAr: إِنَّ الْإِيمَانَ يَبْدَأُ غَرِيبًا وَيَعُودُ غَرِيبًا
textFr: La foi commence étrangère et reviendra étrangère.
textEn: Faith begins as a stranger and will return as a stranger.
sourceAr: عبد الله بن مسعود رضي الله عنه
sourceEn: ‘Abd Allâh ibn Mas‘ûd (may Allah be pleased with him)

textAr: لَا تَكُنْ مِمَّنْ يَخْشَى النَّاسَ فِي اللَّهِ، وَلَا يَخْشَى اللَّهَ فِي النَّاسِ
textFr: Ne sois pas de ceux qui craignent les gens au sujet d'Allah, et ne craignent pas Allah au sujet des gens.
textEn: Do not be among those who fear people regarding Allah, and do not fear Allah regarding people.
sourceEn: Al-Hasan al-Basrî (may Allah have mercy on him)

textAr: مَنْ أَطَالَ الْأَمَلَ سَاءَ الْعَمَلُ
textFr: Celui dont les espoirs sont longs, ses actions se détériorent.
textEn: Whoever has long hopes, his deeds become bad.
sourceAr: عبد الله بن مسعود رضي الله عنه
sourceEn: ‘Abd Allâh ibn Mas‘ûd (may Allah be pleased with him)

textAr: إِنَّ اللَّهَ إِذَا أَحَبَّ عَبْدًا ابْتَلَاهُ وَإِذَا ابْتَلَاهُ صَبَّرَهُ
textFr: Lorsqu'Allah aime un serviteur, Il l'éprouve, et lorsqu'Il l'éprouve, Il le rend patient.
textEn: When Allah loves a servant, He tests him, and when He tests him, He makes him patient.
sourceEn: Sufyân ath-Thawrî (may Allah have mercy on him)

textAr: الْقَنَاعَةُ كَنْزٌ لَا يَفْنَى
textFr: La suffisance est un trésor qui ne s'épuise pas.
textEn: Contentment is a treasure that never perishes.
sourceAr: عمر بن الخطاب رضي الله عنه
sourceEn: ‘Umar ibn al-Khattâb (may Allah be pleased with him)

textAr: رَحِمَ اللَّهُ امْرَأً عَرَفَ قَدْرَهُ وَلَمْ يَتَعَدَّ طَوْرَهُ
textFr: Qu'Allah fasse miséricorde à un homme qui connaît sa valeur et ne dépasse pas sa mesure.
textEn: May Allah have mercy on a man who knows his worth and does not exceed his limits.
sourceAr: علي بن أبي طالب رضي الله عنه
sourceEn: ‘Alî ibn Abî Tâlib (may Allah be pleased with him)

textAr: الصَّبْرُ عَلَى السُّنَّةِ خَيْرٌ مِنَ الصَّبْرِ عَلَى الْجِرَاحِ
textFr: La patience sur la Sunna est meilleure que la patience sur les blessures.
textEn: Patience upon the Sunnah is better than patience upon wounds.
sourceEn: Sufyân ath-Thawrî (may Allah have mercy on him)

textAr: الْعِلْمُ بِاللَّهِ تَأْدِيبٌ، وَالْعِلْمُ بِالدُّنْيَا تَعْذِيبٌ
textFr: La connaissance d'Allah est une éducation, et la connaissance du monde est un châtiment.
textEn: Knowledge of Allah is discipline, and knowledge of this world is torment.
sourceEn: Al-Hasan al-Basrî (may Allah have mercy on him)

textAr: مَنْ عَرَفَ اللَّهَ هَانَتْ عَلَيْهِ الْمُصِيبَاتُ
textFr: Celui qui connaît Allah, les épreuves lui deviennent légères.
textEn: Whoever knows Allah, calamities become easy for him.
sourceEn: Al-Hasan al-Basrî (may Allah have mercy on him)

textAr: أَكْثِرُوا ذِكْرَ اللَّهِ فِي الدُّنْيَا فَلَا تَنْسَوْهُ فِي الْقُبُورِ
textFr: Invoquez beaucoup Allah dans ce monde, afin de ne pas L'oublier dans les tombes.
textEn: Remember Allah often in this world, so that you do not forget Him in the graves.
sourceEn: Al-Hasan al-Basrî (may Allah have mercy on him)

textAr: إِذَا أَرَادَ اللَّهُ بِعَبْدٍ خَيْرًا فَتَحَ لَهُ بَابَ الْعَمَلِ، وَأَغْلَقَ عَنْهُ بَابَ الْجَدَلِ
textFr: Si Allah veut du bien à un serviteur, Il lui ouvre la porte de l'action et Lui ferme la porte de la dispute.
textEn: If Allah wants good for a servant, He opens for him the door of action and closes the door of argumentation.
sourceEn: Sufyân ath-Thawrî (may Allah have mercy on him)

textAr: الْقَلْبُ إِذَا اشْتَغَلَ بِالدُّنْيَا فَاتَتْهُ الْآخِرَةُ
textFr: Si le cœur s'occupe de ce monde, l'au-delà lui échappe.
textEn: If the heart is occupied with this world, the Hereafter escapes it.
sourceEn: Al-Hasan al-Basrî (may Allah have mercy on him)

textAr: لَا تَنْظُرْ إِلَى صِغَرِ الْخَطِيئَةِ، وَلَكِنِ انْظُرْ إِلَى عَظَمَةِ مَنْ عَصَيْتَ
textFr: Ne regarde pas la petitesse du péché, mais regarde la grandeur de Celui que tu désobéis.
textEn: Do not look at the smallness of the sin, but look at the greatness of the One you disobey.
sourceAr: علي بن أبي طالب رضي الله عنه
sourceEn: ‘Alî ibn Abî Tâlib (may Allah be pleased with him)

textAr: عَجِبْتُ لِمَنْ يَبْنِي دَارًا فِي الدُّنْيَا وَيَتْرُكُ دَارًا فِي الْآخِرَةِ
textFr: Je m'étonne de celui qui construit une maison dans ce monde et abandonne sa maison dans l'au-delà.
textEn: I am amazed at the one who builds a house in this world and abandons his house in the Hereafter.
sourceEn: Al-Hasan al-Basrî (may Allah have mercy on him)

textAr: إِنَّ اللَّهَ إِذَا أَحَبَّ عَبْدًا ابْتَلَاهُ، وَإِذَا ابْتَلَاهُ رَزَقَهُ الصَّبْرَ، وَإِذَا رَزَقَهُ الصَّبْرَ اسْتَوْجَبَ الشُّكْرَ
textFr: Lorsqu'Allah aime un serviteur, Il l'éprouve ; et lorsqu'Il l'éprouve, Il lui accorde la patience ; et lorsqu'Il lui accorde la patience, Il le rend digne de reconnaissance.
textEn: When Allah loves a servant, He tests him; and when He tests him, He grants him patience; and when He grants him patience, He makes him worthy of gratitude.
sourceEn: Sufyân ath-Thawrî (may Allah have mercy on him)

textAr: السَّكِينَةُ فِي الْقَلْبِ تَأْتِي مِنَ الْيَقِينِ، وَالْيَقِينُ يَأْتِي مِنَ التَّوَكُّلِ عَلَى اللَّهِ
textFr: La sérénité du cœur vient de la certitude, et la certitude vient de la confiance en Allah.
textEn: Serenity in the heart comes from certainty, and certainty comes from trust in Allah.
sourceEn: Sufyân ath-Thawrî (may Allah have mercy on him)

textAr: مَنْ عَامَلَ النَّاسَ فَلَمْ يَظْلِمْهُمْ، وَحَدَّثَهُمْ فَلَمْ يَكْذِبْهُمْ، وَوَعَدَهُمْ فَلَمْ يُخْلِفْهُمْ، فَذَلِكَ مِمَّنْ كَمُلَتْ مُرُوءَتُهُ
textFr: Celui qui traite les gens sans les opprimer, leur parle sans leur mentir et leur promet sans manquer à sa promesse, celui-là a une virilité parfaite.
textEn: Whoever treats people without oppressing them, speaks to them without lying, and promises them without breaking his promise, that person has perfect manhood.
sourceAr: عبد الله بن مسعود رضي الله عنه
sourceEn: ‘Abd Allâh ibn Mas‘ûd (may Allah be pleased with him)

textAr: إِيَّاكَ وَمُجَالَسَةَ أَهْلِ الْأَهْوَاءِ، فَإِنَّهُمْ مَرْضَى الْقُلُوبِ
textFr: Méfie-toi de la fréquentation des gens de passions, car ils ont les cœurs malades.
textEn: Beware of sitting with the people of desires, for they have diseased hearts.
sourceAr: عبد الله بن مسعود رضي الله عنه
sourceEn: ‘Abd Allâh ibn Mas‘ûd (may Allah be pleased with him)

textAr: مَنْ جَاهَدَ نَفْسَهُ فِي طَاعَةِ اللَّهِ، مَلَكَهَا، وَمَنْ أَهْمَلَهَا، هَلَكَتْ
textFr: Celui qui lutte contre son âme dans l'obéissance à Allah en devient le maître, et celui qui la néglige périt.
textEn: Whoever strives against his soul in obedience to Allah masters it, and whoever neglects it perishes.
sourceAr: علي بن أبي طالب رضي الله عنه
sourceEn: ‘Alî ibn Abî Tâlib (may Allah be pleased with him)

textAr: خَيْرُ النَّاسِ مَنْ نَفَعَ النَّاسَ، وَشَرُّهُمْ مَنْ ضَرَّ النَّاسَ
textFr: Le meilleur des gens est celui qui est utile aux gens, et le pire est celui qui leur nuit.
textEn: The best of people is the one who benefits people, and the worst is the one who harms them.
sourceAr: عبد الله بن مسعود رضي الله عنه
sourceEn: ‘Abd Allâh ibn Mas‘ûd (may Allah be pleased with him)

textAr: الدُّنْيَا دَارُ عُبُورٍ، وَالْآخِرَةُ دَارُ قَرَارٍ، فَخُذُوا مِنْ دَارِ الْعُبُورِ لِدَارِ الْقَرَارِ
textFr: Ce monde est une demeure de passage, et l'au-delà est une demeure d'éternité. Prenez donc de la demeure de passage pour la demeure d'éternité.
textEn: This world is a house of passage, and the Hereafter is a house of eternity. So take from the house of passage for the house of eternity.
sourceEn: Al-Hasan al-Basrî (may Allah have mercy on him)

textAr: إِنَّمَا الدُّنْيَا ثَلَاثَةُ أَيَّامٍ: أَمْسِ فَقَدْ مَضَى، وَغَدٍ فَلَعَلَّكَ لَا تُدْرِكُهُ، وَالْيَوْمِ فَلَكَ فَاعْمَلْ
textFr: La vie de ce monde n'est que de trois jours : hier est passé, demain tu ne l'atteindras peut-être pas, et aujourd'hui est pour toi, agis donc.
textEn: The life of this world is only three days: yesterday has passed, tomorrow you may not reach, and today is for you, so act.
sourceEn: Al-Hasan al-Basrî (may Allah have mercy on him)

textAr: مَنْ أَحَبَّ الْآخِرَةَ تَعَبَ فِي الدُّنْيَا، وَمَنْ أَحَبَّ الدُّنْيَا تَعِبَ فِي الْآخِرَةِ
textFr: Celui qui aime l'au-delà peine dans ce monde, et celui qui aime ce monde peine dans l'au-delà.
textEn: Whoever loves the Hereafter toils in this world, and whoever loves this world toils in the Hereafter.
sourceAr: علي بن أبي طالب رضي الله عنه
sourceEn: ‘Alî ibn Abî Tâlib (may Allah be pleased with him)

textAr: لَيْسَ الْغِنَى عَنْ كَثْرَةِ الْعَرَضِ، وَلَكِنَّ الْغِنَى غِنَى النَّفْسِ
textFr: La richesse ne consiste pas dans l'abondance des biens, mais la richesse est la richesse de l'âme.
textEn: Wealth is not in having many possessions, but wealth is the richness of the soul.
sourceAr: عمر بن الخطاب رضي الله عنه
sourceEn: ‘Umar ibn al-Khattâb (may Allah be pleased with him)

textAr: إِذَا اسْتَيْقَنْتَ رَبَّكَ فَلَا تَهْتَمَّ بِالرِّزْقِ
textFr: Si tu es certain de ton Seigneur, ne t'inquiète pas pour la subsistance.
textEn: If you are certain of your Lord, do not worry about provision.
sourceEn: Sufyân ath-Thawrî (may Allah have mercy on him)

textAr: مَنْ أَصْلَحَ سَرِيرَتَهُ، أَصْلَحَ اللَّهُ عَلَانِيَتَهُ
textFr: Celui qui améliore sa vie intérieure, Allah améliore sa vie extérieure.
textEn: Whoever improves his inner self, Allah improves his outer self.
sourceEn: Sufyân ath-Thawrî (may Allah have mercy on him)

textAr: إِيَّاكَ وَالْغَفْلَةَ، فَإِنَّهَا تَمْنَعُكَ مِنْ ذِكْرِ اللَّهِ
textFr: Méfie-toi de l'insouciance, car elle t'empêche de te souvenir d'Allah.
textEn: Beware of heedlessness, for it prevents you from remembering Allah.
sourceAr: عبد الله بن مسعود رضي الله عنه
sourceEn: ‘Abd Allâh ibn Mas‘ûd (may Allah be pleased with him)

textAr: الْعِبَادَةُ سَبْعُونَ جُزْءًا، أَفْضَلُهَا طَلَبُ الْحَلَالِ
textFr: L'adoration est composée de soixante-dix parts, la meilleure est la recherche du licite.
textEn: Worship is composed of seventy parts, the best of which is seeking the lawful.
sourceEn: Sufyân ath-Thawrî (may Allah have mercy on him)

textAr: مَنْ عَرَفَ نَفْسَهُ عَرَفَ رَبَّهُ
textFr: Celui qui connaît son âme connaît son Seigneur.
textEn: Whoever knows his soul knows his Lord.
sourceAr: علي بن أبي طالب رضي الله عنه
sourceEn: ‘Alî ibn Abî Tâlib (may Allah be pleased with him)

textAr: الصَّمْتُ سَلَامَةٌ، وَالْعَمَلُ عِبَادَةٌ، وَالْعِلْمُ حَيَاةٌ
textFr: Le silence est sécurité, l'action est adoration, et la science est vie.
textEn: Silence is safety, action is worship, and knowledge is life.
sourceAr: عمر بن الخطاب رضي الله عنه
sourceEn: ‘Umar ibn al-Khattâb (may Allah be pleased with him)

textAr: لَا تَحْسَبَنَّ الْخَطِيئَةَ صَغِيرَةً، فَإِنَّهَا تَزِيدُ حَتَّى تَكُونَ كَبِيرَةً
textFr: Ne pense pas que le péché soit petit, car il augmente jusqu'à devenir grand.
textEn: Do not think that a sin is small, for it increases until it becomes great.
sourceEn: Sufyân ath-Thawrî (may Allah have mercy on him)

textAr: إِنَّمَا يَهَابُكَ النَّاسُ عَلَى قَدْرِ هَيْبَتِكَ لِلَّهِ
textFr: Les gens ne te craignent qu'à proportion de ta crainte d'Allah.
textEn: People only fear you to the extent of your fear of Allah.
sourceEn: Al-Fudayl ibn ‘Iyâd (may Allah have mercy on him)

textAr: ذِكْرُ اللَّهِ شِفَاءُ الْقُلُوبِ، وَذِكْرُ النَّاسِ دَاءٌ
textFr: Le rappel d'Allah est un remède pour les cœurs, et le rappel des gens est une maladie.
textEn: The remembrance of Allah is a cure for the hearts, and the remembrance of people is a disease.
sourceEn: Al-Fudayl ibn ‘Iyâd (may Allah have mercy on him)

textAr: كُنْ فِي الدُّنْيَا كَأَنَّكَ غَرِيبٌ أَوْ عَابِرُ سَبِيلٍ
textFr: Sois dans ce monde comme un étranger ou un voyageur de passage.
textEn: Be in this world as if you were a stranger or a passerby.
sourceAr: عبد الله بن عمر رضي الله عنهما
sourceEn: ‘Abd Allâh ibn ‘Umar (may Allah be pleased with them)

textAr: الْمُؤْمِنُ مِسْكِينٌ، وَالْمُؤْمِنُ أُخُو الْمُؤْمِنِ، وَالْمُؤْمِنُ يَأْلَفُ وَيُؤْلَفُ
textFr: Le croyant est humble, le croyant est le frère du croyant, et le croyant est sociable et apprécié.
textEn: The believer is humble, the believer is the brother of the believer, and the believer is sociable and liked.
sourceAr: عبد الله بن مسعود رضي الله عنه
sourceEn: ‘Abd Allâh ibn Mas‘ûd (may Allah be pleased with him)

textAr: مَنْ أَحَبَّ أَنْ يُعْطِيَهُ اللَّهُ الْعِلْمَ وَلَمْ يَعْمَلْ بِهِ، كَانَ كَالْحِمَارِ يَحْمِلُ أَسْفَارًا
textFr: Celui qui aime recevoir la science d'Allah sans agir selon elle, est comme l'âne qui porte des livres.
textEn: Whoever loves to receive knowledge from Allah but does not act upon it, is like a donkey carrying books.
sourceEn: Al-Hasan al-Basrî (may Allah have mercy on him)

textAr: الْإِخْلَاصُ سِرٌّ بَيْنَ اللَّهِ وَبَيْنَ عَبْدِهِ، لَا يَعْلَمُهُ مَلَكٌ فَيَكْتُبَهُ، وَلَا شَيْطَانٌ فَيُفْسِدَهُ
textFr: La sincérité est un secret entre Allah et Son serviteur, qu'aucun ange ne connaît pour l'écrire, ni aucun démon pour le corrompre.
textEn: Sincerity is a secret between Allah and His servant, which no angel knows to write, nor any devil to corrupt.
sourceEn: Sufyân ath-Thawrî (may Allah have mercy on him)

textAr: الْحَيَاءُ رَاحَةُ الْقَلْبِ، وَالْكِبْرُ عَذَابُ النَّفْسِ
textFr: La pudeur est le repos du cœur, et l'orgueil est le châtiment de l'âme.
textEn: Modesty is the rest of the heart, and pride is the torment of the soul.
sourceAr: عمر بن الخطاب رضي الله عنه
sourceEn: ‘Umar ibn al-Khattâb (may Allah be pleased with him)

textAr: لَا تَسُبَّنَّ أَحَدًا، فَإِنَّ السَّبَّ يَرُدُّ عَلَى صَاحِبِهِ
textFr: N'insulte jamais personne, car l'insulte retombe sur son auteur.
textEn: Never insult anyone, for the insult returns to its author.
sourceAr: علي بن أبي طالب رضي الله عنه
sourceEn: ‘Alî ibn Abî Tâlib (may Allah be pleased with him)

textAr: السَّعَادَةُ لَيْسَتْ فِي كَثْرَةِ الْمَالِ، وَلَكِنْ فِي طُمَأْنِينَةِ الْقَلْبِ
textFr: Le bonheur ne réside pas dans l'abondance des biens, mais dans la sérénité du cœur.
textEn: Happiness is not in having much wealth, but in the tranquility of the heart.
sourceAr: عبد الله بن مسعود رضي الله عنه
sourceEn: ‘Abd Allâh ibn Mas‘ûd (may Allah be pleased with him)

textAr: إِذَا رَأَيْتَ الرَّجُلَ يُحِبُّ الذِّكْرَ فَاعْلَمْ أَنَّ اللَّهَ يُحِبُّهُ
textFr: Si tu vois un homme aimer le rappel d'Allah, sache qu'Allah l'aime.
textEn: If you see a man loving the remembrance of Allah, know that Allah loves him.
sourceEn: Al-Hasan al-Basrî (may Allah have mercy on him)

textAr: مَنْ أَحَبَّ الْعُزْلَةَ فَقَدْ سَلِمَ مِنَ النَّاسِ، وَمَنْ سَلِمَ مِنَ النَّاسِ سَلِمَ دِينُهُ
textFr: Celui qui aime la solitude s'est préservé des gens, et celui qui s'est préservé des gens a préservé sa religion.
textEn: Whoever loves solitude has saved himself from people, and whoever saves himself from people has saved his religion.
sourceEn: Sufyân ath-Thawrî (may Allah have mercy on him)

textAr: الْعَمَلُ بِالسُّنَّةِ رَأْسُ الْحِكْمَةِ
textFr: Agir selon la Sunna est la tête de la sagesse.
textEn: Acting upon the Sunnah is the head of wisdom.
sourceEn: Sufyân ath-Thawrî (may Allah have mercy on him)

textAr: خَالِطُوا النَّاسَ بِأَخْلَاقِ الْإِسْلَامِ، وَاعْتَزِلُوا عَنْ أَهْلِ الْبِدَعِ
textFr: Fréquentez les gens avec les caractères de l'Islam, et éloignez-vous des gens de l'innovation.
textEn: Mix with people with the manners of Islam, and keep away from the people of innovation.
sourceAr: عبد الله بن مسعود رضي الله عنه
sourceEn: ‘Abd Allâh ibn Mas‘ûd (may Allah be pleased with him)

textAr: مَنْ كَثُرَ صَمْتُهُ كَثُرَ وَقَارُهُ، وَمَنْ كَثُرَ كَلَامُهُ كَثُرَ سَقَطُهُ
textFr: Celui dont le silence est abondant, sa dignité est grande ; et celui dont les paroles sont nombreuses, ses erreurs sont nombreuses.
textEn: Whoever's silence is abundant, his dignity is great; and whoever's speech is abundant, his mistakes are many.
sourceAr: عمر بن الخطاب رضي الله عنه
sourceEn: ‘Umar ibn al-Khattâb (may Allah be pleased with him)

textAr: الْعِلْمُ يَنْقُصُ بِالتَّرْكِ، وَيَزِيدُ بِالْعَمَلِ
textFr: La science diminue par l'abandon et augmente par la pratique.
textEn: Knowledge decreases by abandonment and increases by practice.
sourceEn: Sufyân ath-Thawrî (may Allah have mercy on him)

textAr: إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُحِبُّ الْعَبْدَ التَّقِيَّ الْغَنِيَّ الْخَفِيَّ
textFr: Allah aime le serviteur pieux, riche (de cœur) et discret.
textEn: Allah loves the pious servant, rich (of heart) and discreet.
sourceEn: Al-Fudayl ibn ‘Iyâd (may Allah have mercy on him)

textAr: لَا تَرْكَنُوا إِلَى الدُّنْيَا، فَإِنَّهَا لَيْسَتْ بِدَارِ قَرَارٍ
textFr: Ne vous appuyez pas sur ce monde, car il n'est pas une demeure d'éternité.
textEn: Do not rely on this world, for it is not a place of permanence.
sourceAr: علي بن أبي طالب رضي الله عنه
sourceEn: ‘Alî ibn Abî Tâlib (may Allah be pleased with him)

textAr: إِنَّ الْإِيمَانَ يَبْدَأُ غَرِيبًا وَيَعُودُ غَرِيبًا
textFr: La foi commence étrangère et reviendra étrangère.
textEn: Faith begins as a stranger and will return as a stranger.
sourceAr: عبد الله بن مسعود رضي الله عنه
sourceEn: ‘Abd Allâh ibn Mas‘ûd (may Allah be pleased with him)

textAr: لَا تَكُنْ مِمَّنْ يَخْشَى النَّاسَ فِي اللَّهِ، وَلَا يَخْشَى اللَّهَ فِي النَّاسِ
textFr: Ne sois pas de ceux qui craignent les gens au sujet d'Allah, et ne craignent pas Allah au sujet des gens.
textEn: Do not be among those who fear people regarding Allah, and do not fear Allah regarding people.
sourceEn: Al-Hasan al-Basrî (may Allah have mercy on him)

textAr: مَنْ أَطَالَ الْأَمَلَ سَاءَ الْعَمَلُ
textFr: Celui dont les espoirs sont longs, ses actions se détériorent.
textEn: Whoever has long hopes, his deeds become bad.
sourceAr: عبد الله بن مسعود رضي الله عنه
sourceEn: ‘Abd Allâh ibn Mas‘ûd (may Allah be pleased with him)

textAr: إِنَّ اللَّهَ إِذَا أَحَبَّ عَبْدًا ابْتَلَاهُ وَإِذَا ابْتَلَاهُ صَبَّرَهُ
textFr: Lorsqu'Allah aime un serviteur, Il l'éprouve, et lorsqu'Il l'éprouve, Il le rend patient.
textEn: When Allah loves a servant, He tests him, and when He tests him, He makes him patient.
sourceEn: Sufyân ath-Thawrî (may Allah have mercy on him)

textAr: الْقَنَاعَةُ كَنْزٌ لَا يَفْنَى
textFr: La suffisance est un trésor qui ne s'épuise pas.
textEn: Contentment is a treasure that never perishes.
sourceAr: عمر بن الخطاب رضي الله عنه
sourceEn: ‘Umar ibn al-Khattâb (may Allah be pleased with him)

textAr: رَحِمَ اللَّهُ امْرَأً عَرَفَ قَدْرَهُ وَلَمْ يَتَعَدَّ طَوْرَهُ
textFr: Qu'Allah fasse miséricorde à un homme qui connaît sa valeur et ne dépasse pas sa mesure.
textEn: May Allah have mercy on a man who knows his worth and does not exceed his limits.
sourceAr: علي بن أبي طالب رضي الله عنه
sourceEn: ‘Alî ibn Abî Tâlib (may Allah be pleased with him)

textAr: مَنْ خَافَ اللَّهَ لَمْ يَضُرَّهُ أَحَدٌ، وَمَنْ خَافَ غَيْرَ اللَّهِ لَمْ يَنْفَعْهُ أَحَدٌ
textFr: Celui qui craint Allah, personne ne lui nuit ; et celui qui craint autre qu'Allah, personne ne lui profite.
textEn: Whoever fears Allah, no one will harm him; and whoever fears other than Allah, no one will benefit him.
sourceEn: Al-Fudayl ibn ‘Iyâd (may Allah have mercy on him)

textAr: إِيَّاكَ وَالرِّيَاءَ، فَإِنَّهُ شِرْكٌ أَصْغَرُ
textFr: Méfie-toi de l'ostentation, car c'est un polythéisme mineur.
textEn: Beware of showing off, for it is minor polytheism.
sourceEn: Sufyân ath-Thawrî (may Allah have mercy on him)

textAr: خَلَقَ اللَّهُ الْمَلَائِكَةَ عُقُولًا بِلَا شَهْوَةٍ، وَخَلَقَ الْبَهَائِمَ شَهْوَةً بِلَا عُقُولٍ، وَخَلَقَ ابْنَ آدَمَ وَرَكَّبَ فِيهِ الْعَقْلَ وَالشَّهْوَةَ، فَمَنْ غَلَبَ عَقْلُهُ شَهْوَتَهُ الْتَحَقَ بِالْمَلَائِكَةِ، وَمَنْ غَلَبَتْ شَهْوَتُهُ عَقْلَهُ الْتَحَقَ بِالْبَهَائِمِ
textFr: Allah a créé les anges avec des intelligences sans passions, et a créé les bêtes avec des passions sans intelligences, et a créé le fils d'Adam en y plaçant l'intelligence et la passion. Celui dont l'intelligence domine sa passion rejoint les anges, et celui dont la passion domine son intelligence rejoint les bêtes.
textEn: Allah created the angels with intellects without desires, and created the beasts with desires without intellects, and created the son of Adam combining intellect and desire. Whoever's intellect overcomes his desire joins the angels, and whoever's desire overcomes his intellect joins the beasts.
sourceEn: Some of the Salaf

textAr: مَا عَالَجْتُ شَيْئًا أَشَدَّ عَلَيَّ مِنْ نَفْسِي، مَرَّةً لِي وَمَرَّةً عَلَيَّ
textFr: Je n'ai rien combattu de plus difficile que mon âme, parfois elle est pour moi et parfois contre moi.
textEn: I have not fought anything more difficult than my soul, sometimes it is for me and sometimes against me.
sourceEn: Sufyân ath-Thawrî (may Allah have mercy on him)

textAr: رَحِمَ اللَّهُ عَبْدًا قَالَ لِنَفْسِهِ : أَلَسْتِ صَاحِبَةَ كَذَا ؟ أَلَسْتِ صَاحِبَةَ كَذَا ؟ ثُمَّ ذَمَّهَا، ثُمَّ خَطَمَهَا، ثُمَّ أَلْزَمَهَا كِتَابَ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى فَكَانَ لَهَا قَائِدًا
textFr: Qu'Allah fasse miséricorde à un serviteur qui dit à son âme : N'es-tu pas celle qui a fait ceci et cela ? Puis il la blâme, puis il la bride, puis il l'oblige à suivre le Livre d'Allah et en fait son guide.
textEn: May Allah have mercy on a servant who says to his soul: Are you not the one who did this and that? Then he blames it, then he bridles it, then he forces it to follow the Book of Allah and makes it his guide.
sourceFr: Mâlik ibn Dînâr (qu'Allah lui fasse miséricorde)
sourceEn: Mâlik ibn Dînâr (may Allah have mercy on him)

textAr: اسْتَعِنْ عَلَى سَيْرِكَ إِلَى اللَّهِ بِتَرْكِ مَنْ شَغَلَكَ عَنِ اللَّهِ، وَلَيْسَ بِشَاغِلٍ يَشْغَلُكَ عَنِ اللَّهِ كَنَفْسِكَ الَّتِي هِيَ بَيْنَ جَنْبَيْكَ
textFr: Aide-toi dans ta marche vers Allah en abandonnant ce qui te distrait de Lui, et il n'y a pas de distraction plus grande que ton âme qui est entre tes flancs.
textEn: Seek help in your journey to Allah by abandoning what distracts you from Him, and there is no greater distraction than your own soul which is between your sides.
sourceFr: Abû Bakr al-Warrâq (qu'Allah lui fasse miséricorde)
sourceEn: Abû Bakr al-Warrâq (may Allah have mercy on him)

textAr: مَنْ أَعَزَّ نَفْسَهُ أَذَلَّ دِينَهُ، وَمَنْ أَذَلَّ نَفْسَهُ أَعَزَّ دِينَهُ
textFr: Celui qui honore son âme avilit sa religion, et celui qui avilit son âme honore sa religion.
textEn: Whoever honors his soul debases his religion, and whoever debases his soul honors his religion.
sourceEn: Mujâhid (may Allah have mercy on him)

textAr: الزُّهْدُ فِي الدُّنْيَا هُوَ الزُّهْدُ فِي النَّاسِ، وَأَوَّلُ ذَلِكَ زُهْدُكَ فِي نَفْسِكَ
textFr: L'ascèse dans ce monde consiste à se détacher des gens, et le commencement de cela est de te détacher de toi-même.
textEn: Asceticism in this world is detachment from people, and the beginning of that is detachment from yourself.
sourceEn: Sufyân ath-Thawrî (may Allah have mercy on him)

textAr: لَا يَفْقَهُ الرَّجُلُ كُلَّ الْفِقْهِ حَتَّى يَرَى النَّاسَ فِي جَنْبِ اللَّهِ أَمْثَالَ الْأَبَاعِرِ، ثُمَّ يَرْجِعَ إِلَى نَفْسِهِ فَيَكُونَ لَهَا أَحْقَرَ حَاقِرٍ
textFr: Un homme n'acquiert pas une pleine compréhension de la religion jusqu'à ce qu'il considère les gens, auprès d'Allah, comme des chameaux, puis qu'il revienne à lui-même et se considère comme le plus insignifiant.
textEn: A man does not gain full understanding of religion until he considers people, in the sight of Allah, as camels, and then returns to himself and considers himself the most insignificant.
sourceFr: Khâlid ibn Ma‘dân (qu'Allah lui fasse miséricorde)
sourceEn: Khâlid ibn Ma‘dân (may Allah have mercy on him)

textAr: رَحِمَ اللَّهُ عَبْدًا وَقَفَ عِنْدَ هَمِّهِ، فَإِنْ كَانَ لِلَّهِ مَضَى، وَإِنْ كَانَ لِغَيْرِهِ تَأَخَّرَ
textFr: Qu'Allah fasse miséricorde à un serviteur qui s'arrête devant son souci : s'il est pour Allah, il avance ; s'il est pour autre chose, il recule.
textEn: May Allah have mercy on a servant who pauses at his concern: if it is for Allah, he proceeds; if it is for other than Him, he retreats.
sourceEn: Al-Hasan al-Basrî (may Allah have mercy on him)

textAr: لَمَّا نَظَرْتُ إِلَى أَهْلِ عَرَفَاتٍ ظَنَنْتُ أَنَّهُمْ قَدْ غُفِرَ لَهُمْ، لَوْلَا أَنَّنِي كُنْتُ فِيهِمْ
textFr: Lorsque j'ai regardé les gens de ‘Arafât, j'ai pensé qu'ils avaient tous été pardonnés, n'eût été que j'étais parmi eux.
textEn: When I looked at the people of ‘Arafât, I thought they had all been forgiven, were it not that I was among them.
sourceAr: بكر بن عبد الله المزني رحمه الله
sourceFr: Bakr ibn ‘Abd Allâh al-Muzanî (qu'Allah lui fasse miséricorde)
sourceEn: Bakr ibn ‘Abd Allâh al-Muzanî (may Allah have mercy on him)

textAr: إِنِّي لَأَجِدُ مِائَةَ خَصْلَةٍ مِنْ خِصَالِ الْخَيْرِ، مَا أَعْلَمُ أَنَّ فِي نَفْسِي مِنْهَا وَاحِدَةً
textFr: Je trouve cent qualités du bien, et je ne sais si mon âme en possède une seule.
textEn: I find one hundred qualities of goodness, and I do not know if my soul possesses a single one of them.
sourceEn: Yûnus ibn ‘Ubayd (may Allah have mercy on him)

textAr: مَا زَالَتِ التَّقْوَى بِالْمُتَّقِينَ حَتَّى تَرَكُوا كَثِيرًا مِنَ الْحَلَالِ مَخَافَةَ الْحَرَامِ
textFr: La piété n'a cessé d'habiter les pieux jusqu'à ce qu'ils aient abandonné beaucoup de choses licites par crainte de l'illicite.
textEn: Piety has continued to dwell in the pious until they abandoned much of the lawful for fear of the unlawful.
sourceEn: Al-Hasan al-Basrî (may Allah have mercy on him)

textAr: مَا زِلْتُ أَقُودُ نَفْسِي إِلَى اللَّهِ وَهِيَ تَبْكِي، حَتَّى سُقْتُهَا وَهِيَ تَضْحَكُ
textFr: Je n'ai cessé de conduire mon âme vers Allah alors qu'elle pleurait, jusqu'à ce que je la conduise alors qu'elle rit.
textEn: I kept leading my soul to Allah while it was crying, until I led it while it was laughing.
sourceFr: Abû Yazîd al-Bistâmî (qu'Allah lui fasse miséricorde)
sourceEn: Abû Yazîd al-Bistâmî (may Allah have mercy on him)

textAr: مِنْ عَلَامَةِ إِعْرَاضِ اللَّهِ عَنِ الْعَبْدِ أَنْ يَجْعَلَ شُغْلَهُ فِيمَا لَا يَعْنِيهِ
textFr: Parmi les signes qu'Allah se détourne d'un serviteur, c'est qu'Il lui fasse son occupation de ce qui ne le concerne pas.
textEn: Among the signs that Allah has turned away from a servant is that He makes his occupation that which does not concern him.
sourceEn: Al-Hasan al-Basrî (may Allah have mercy on him)

textAr: مَنِ اشْتَغَلَ بِالْفُضُولِ حُرِمَ الْوَرَعَ
textFr: Celui qui s'occupe des choses superflues est privé de la scrupulosité.
textEn: Whoever occupies himself with superfluous things is deprived of scrupulousness.
sourceEn: Sahl (may Allah have mercy on him)

textAr: كَلَامُ الْعَبْدِ فِيمَا لَا يَعْنِيهِ، خِذْلَانٌ مِنَ اللَّهِ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ
textFr: La parole du serviteur dans ce qui ne le concerne pas est un abandon de la part d'Allah.
textEn: The servant's speech about what does not concern him is a forsaking from Allah.
sourceEn: Ma‘rûf al-Karkhî (may Allah have mercy on him)

textAr: الْقُلُوبُ كَالْقُدُورِ تَغْلِي بِمَا فِيهَا، وَأَلْسِنَتُهَا مَغَارِفُهَا، فَانْظُرْ إِلَى الرَّجُلِ حِينَ يَتَكَلَّمُ، فَإِنَّ لِسَانَهُ يَغْتَرِفُ لَكَ مِمَّا فِي قَلْبِهِ
textFr: Les cœurs sont comme des marmites qui bouillent avec ce qu'elles contiennent, et les langues sont leurs louches. Regarde donc l'homme lorsqu'il parle : sa langue te puise ce qu'il y a dans son cœur.
textEn: Hearts are like pots that boil with what they contain, and tongues are their ladles. So look at a man when he speaks: his tongue scoops for you what is in his heart.
sourceFr: Yahyâ ibn Mu‘âdh (qu'Allah lui fasse miséricorde)
sourceEn: Yahyâ ibn Mu‘âdh (may Allah have mercy on him)

textAr: إِنَّ الْأَبْرَارَ لَتَغْلِي قُلُوبُهُمْ بِأَعْمَالِ الْبِرِّ، وَإِنَّ الْفُجَّارَ تَغْلِي قُلُوبُهُمْ بِأَعْمَالِ الْفُجُورِ، وَاللَّهُ يَرَى هُمُومَكُمْ، فَانْظُرُوا مَا هُمُومُكُمْ
textFr: Les cœurs des pieux bouillent d'œuvres pies, et les cœurs des dépravés bouillent d'œuvres dépravées. Allah voit vos préoccupations, regardez donc quelles sont vos préoccupations.
textEn: The hearts of the righteous boil with righteous deeds, and the hearts of the wicked boil with wicked deeds. Allah sees your concerns, so look at what your concerns are.
sourceFr: Mâlik ibn Dînâr (qu'Allah lui fasse miséricorde)
sourceEn: Mâlik ibn Dînâr (may Allah have mercy on him)

textAr: أَوَّلُ بِدْعَةٍ حَدَثَتْ بَعْدَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم : الشِّبَعُ، إِنَّ الْقَوْمَ لَمَّا شَبِعَتْ بُطُونُهُمْ، جَمَحَتْ بِهِمْ نُفُوسُهُمْ إِلَى الدُّنْيَا
textFr: La première innovation apparue après le Messager d'Allah (paix et salut sur lui) est la satiété. Lorsque les gens eurent le ventre plein, leurs âmes les emportèrent vers ce monde.
textEn: The first innovation to appear after the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) was satiety. When people's stomachs became full, their souls carried them away towards this world.
sourceEn: ‘Â'ishah (may Allah be pleased with her)

textAr: لَا تُجَالِسْ أَهْلَ الْأَهْوَاءِ فَإِنَّ مُجَالَسَتَهُمْ مُمَرِّضَةٌ لِلْقَلْبِ
textFr: Ne fréquente pas les gens de passions, car leur fréquentation est une maladie pour le cœur.
textEn: Do not sit with the people of desires, for their company is a sickness for the heart.
sourceAr: عبد الله بن عباس رضي الله عنهما
sourceEn: ‘Abd Allâh ibn ‘Abbâs (may Allah be pleased with them)

textAr: لَأَنْ أُجَالِسَ الْخَنَازِيرَ، أَحَبُّ إِلَيَّ مِنْ أَنْ أُجَالِسَ رَجُلًا مِنْ أَهْلِ الْأَهْوَاءِ
textFr: Il m'est plus agréable de fréquenter des porcs que de fréquenter un homme parmi les gens de passions.
textEn: It is more pleasing to me to sit with pigs than to sit with a man from the people of desires.
sourceEn: Abû al-Jawzâ' (may Allah have mercy on him)

textAr: صَبْرُكَ عَلَى السُّنَّةِ خَيْرٌ مِنْ صَبْرِكَ عَلَى السَّيْفِ
textFr: Ta patience sur la Sunna est meilleure que ta patience sur l'épée.
textEn: Your patience upon the Sunnah is better than your patience upon the sword.
sourceEn: Al-Awzâ‘î (may Allah have mercy on him)

textAr: قِفْ حَيْثُ وَقَفَ الْقَوْمُ، وَقُلْ مَا قَالُوا، وَكُفَّ عَمَّا كَفُّوا عَنْهُ، وَاتَّبِعْ سَبِيلَ سَلَفِكَ الصَّالِحِ، فَإِنَّهُ يَكْفِيكَ مَا كَفَاهُمْ
textFr: Arrête-toi là où les gens (les pieux prédécesseurs) se sont arrêtés, dis ce qu'ils ont dit, abstiens-toi de ce dont ils se sont abstenus, et suis la voie de tes pieux prédécesseurs, car ce qui leur a suffi te suffira.
textEn: Stop where the people (the pious predecessors) stopped, say what they said, abstain from what they abstained from, and follow the path of your pious predecessors, for what sufficed them will suffice you.
sourceEn: Al-Awzâ‘î (may Allah have mercy on him)

textAr: إِنَّ الْبِدْعَةَ أَحَبُّ إِلَى إِبْلِيسَ مِنَ الْمَعْصِيَةِ، لِأَنَّ الْمَعْصِيَةَ يُتَابُ مِنْهَا، وَالْبِدْعَةَ لَا يُتَابُ مِنْهَا
textFr: L'innovation est plus aimée d'Iblis que le péché, car on se repent du péché, mais on ne se repent pas de l'innovation.
textEn: Innovation is more beloved to Iblis than sin, because one repents from sin, but one does not repent from innovation.
sourceEn: Sufyân ath-Thawrî (may Allah have mercy on him)

textAr: مَنْ كَتَمَنَا بِدْعَتَهُ لَمْ يَكْتُمْ عَنَّا مُجَالَسَتَهُ
textFr: Celui qui nous cache son innovation, ne nous cachera pas ses fréquentations.
textEn: Whoever hides his innovation from us will not hide his company from us.
sourceEn: Al-Awzâ‘î (may Allah have mercy on him)

textAr: لَا خَيْرَ فِي الْعِلْمِ إِذَا لَمْ يُرِدْ بِهِ صَاحِبُهُ وَجْهَ اللَّهِ
textFr: Il n'y a pas de bien dans la science si son possesseur ne recherche pas par elle le Visage d'Allah.
textEn: There is no good in knowledge if its possessor does not seek by it the Face of Allah.
sourceEn: Al-Hasan al-Basrî (may Allah have mercy on him)

textAr: إِذَا جَاءَكَ الْغَضَبُ فَاذْكُرِ الْحِلْمَ، وَإِذَا جَاءَكَ الْعَجْزُ فَاذْكُرِ الْقُدْرَةَ، وَإِذَا جَاءَكَ الْكِبْرُ فَاذْكُرِ التَّوَاضُعَ
textFr: Lorsque la colère vient à toi, souviens-toi de la clémence ; lorsque l'impuissance vient à toi, souviens-toi de la puissance ; lorsque l'orgueil vient à toi, souviens-toi de l'humilité.
textEn: When anger comes to you, remember forbearance; when helplessness comes to you, remember power; when pride comes to you, remember humility.
sourceEn: Some of the Salaf

textAr: إِنَّ اللَّهَ إِذَا أَرَادَ بِعَبْدٍ خَيْرًا فَتَحَ لَهُ بَابَ الْعَمَلِ وَأَغْلَقَ عَنْهُ بَابَ الْجَدَلِ
textFr: Lorsqu'Allah veut du bien à un serviteur, Il lui ouvre la porte de l'action et lui ferme la porte de la dispute.
textEn: When Allah wants good for a servant, He opens for him the door of action and closes for him the door of argumentation.
sourceEn: Sufyân ath-Thawrî (may Allah have mercy on him)

textAr: رَأْسُ الْحِكْمَةِ مَخَافَةُ اللَّهِ
textFr: Le commencement de la sagesse est la crainte d'Allah.
textEn: The beginning of wisdom is the fear of Allah.
sourceEn: Some of the Salaf

textAr: مَنْ عَرَفَ اللَّهَ أَحَبَّهُ، وَمَنْ أَحَبَّ اللَّهَ أَطَاعَهُ، وَمَنْ أَطَاعَ اللَّهَ نَجَا
textFr: Celui qui connaît Allah L'aime, celui qui aime Allah Lui obéit, et celui qui obéit à Allah est sauvé.
textEn: Whoever knows Allah loves Him, whoever loves Allah obeys Him, and whoever obeys Allah is saved.
sourceEn: Some of the Salaf

textAr: لَا تَنْظُرْ إِلَى مَنْ تَكَلَّمَ، وَلَكِنِ انْظُرْ إِلَى مَا تَكَلَّمَ بِهِ
textFr: Ne regarde pas celui qui parle, mais regarde ce qu'il dit.
textEn: Do not look at the one who speaks, but look at what he says.
sourceEn: Some of the Salaf

textAr: الْقَلْبُ مَلِكُ الْجَسَدِ، فَإِذَا صَلَحَ الْمَلِكُ صَلَحَ الْجُنْدُ، وَإِذَا فَسَدَ الْمَلِكُ فَسَدَ الْجُنْدُ
textFr: Le cœur est le roi du corps. Si le roi est bon, les soldats sont bons ; si le roi est corrompu, les soldats sont corrompus.
textEn: The heart is the king of the body. If the king is good, the soldiers are good; if the king is corrupt, the soldiers are corrupt.
sourceEn: Some of the Salaf

textAr: مَنْ أَكْثَرَ ذِكْرَ الْمَوْتِ رَضِيَ مِنَ الدُّنْيَا بِالْيَسِيرِ
textFr: Celui qui multiplie le souvenir de la mort se contente de peu de ce monde.
textEn: Whoever frequently remembers death is content with little of this world.
sourceEn: Some of the Salaf

textAr: إِذَا أَرَدْتَ أَنْ تَعْلَمَ مَكَانَتَكَ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ، فَانْظُرْ إِلَى مَكَانَةِ اللَّهِ عِنْدَكَ
textFr: Si tu veux connaître ta place auprès d'Allah, regarde la place qu'Allah occupe auprès de toi.
textEn: If you want to know your standing with Allah, look at the standing Allah has with you.
sourceEn: Some of the Salaf

textAr: أَحْسِنُوا الظَّنَّ بِاللَّهِ، فَإِنَّ حُسْنَ الظَّنِّ بِاللَّهِ مِنْ حُسْنِ الْعِبَادَةِ
textFr: Ayez une bonne opinion d'Allah, car la bonne opinion d'Allah fait partie de la bonne adoration.
textEn: Have a good opinion of Allah, for having a good opinion of Allah is part of good worship.
sourceEn: Some of the Salaf

textAr: مَنْ أَحَبَّ شَيْئًا أَكْثَرَ ذِكْرَهُ، وَمَنْ أَكْثَرَ ذِكْرَ شَيْءٍ مَلَكَ قَلْبَهُ
textFr: Celui qui aime une chose en fait beaucoup le rappel, et celui qui fait beaucoup le rappel d'une chose voit son cœur en être possédé.
textEn: Whoever loves something frequently remembers it, and whoever frequently remembers something has his heart possessed by it.
sourceEn: Some of the Salaf

textAr: لَا تَكُنْ عَبْدَ النَّاسِ، كُنْ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ
textFr: Ne sois pas l'esclave des gens, sois l'esclave d'Allah.
textEn: Do not be a slave of people, be a slave of Allah.
sourceEn: Some of the Salaf

textAr: إِنَّ الْعَبْدَ إِذَا أَذْنَبَ ذَنْبًا نُكِتَ فِي قَلْبِهِ نُكْتَةٌ سَوْدَاءُ، فَإِنْ تَابَ صُقِلَ قَلْبُهُ، وَإِنْ زَادَ زَادَتْ
textFr: Lorsque le serviteur commet un péché, une tache noire est marquée dans son cœur. S'il se repent, son cœur est poli ; s'il augmente (les péchés), la tache augmente.
textEn: When the servant commits a sin, a black spot is marked in his heart. If he repents, his heart is polished; if he increases (in sin), the spot increases.
sourceEn: Some of the Salaf

textAr: إِنَّمَا الْعِلْمُ بِالتَّعَلُّمِ، وَإِنَّمَا الْحِلْمُ بِالتَّحَلُّمِ
textFr: La science s'acquiert par l'apprentissage, et la clémence s'acquiert par la pratique.
textEn: Knowledge is acquired by learning, and forbearance is acquired by practice.
sourceEn: Some of the Salaf

textAr: مَنْ رَضِيَ عَنِ اللَّهِ فِي الْبَلَاءِ، رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ فِي الْعَطَاءِ
textFr: Celui qui est satisfait d'Allah dans l'épreuve, Allah est satisfait de lui dans la faveur.
textEn: Whoever is content with Allah in affliction, Allah is content with him in favor.
sourceEn: Some of the Salaf

textAr: لَا تَكُنْ مِمَّنْ يُحِبُّ الدُّنْيَا فَيَكْرَهُ الْمَوْتَ، وَيُحِبُّ الْآخِرَةَ فَيَكْرَهُ الْعَمَلَ
textFr: Ne sois pas de ceux qui aiment ce monde et détestent la mort, et qui aiment l'au-delà et détestent l'action.
textEn: Do not be among those who love this world and hate death, and who love the Hereafter and hate action.
sourceEn: Some of the Salaf

textAr: خَيْرُ الْأُمُورِ أَوْسَاطُهَا
textFr: Les meilleures choses sont celles qui sont modérées.
textEn: The best of things are those that are moderate.
sourceEn: Some of the Salaf

textAr: مَنْ أَحَبَّ اللَّهَ أَحَبَّ ذِكْرَهُ، وَمَنْ أَحَبَّ ذِكْرَهُ أَحَبَّ طَاعَتَهُ
textFr: Celui qui aime Allah aime Son rappel, et celui qui aime Son rappel aime Son obéissance.
textEn: Whoever loves Allah loves His remembrance, and whoever loves His remembrance loves His obedience.
sourceEn: Some of the Salaf

textAr: إِذَا أَرَدْتَ أَنْ تَعْرِفَ عَبْدًا، فَانْظُرْ إِلَى مَنْ يُصَاحِبُ وَمَنْ يُجَالِسُ
textFr: Si tu veux connaître un serviteur, regarde avec qui il se lie et avec qui il s'assied.
textEn: If you want to know a servant, look at whom he befriends and with whom he sits.
sourceEn: Some of the Salaf

textAr: الْإِخْلَاصُ أَنْ لَا تَطْلُبَ عَلَى عَمَلِكَ شَاهِدًا غَيْرَ اللَّهِ
textFr: La sincérité est de ne rechercher pour ton œuvre aucun témoin autre qu'Allah.
textEn: Sincerity is not to seek for your deed any witness other than Allah.
sourceEn: Some of the Salaf

textAr: مَنْ عَرَفَ نَفْسَهُ عَرَفَ رَبَّهُ، وَمَنْ عَرَفَ رَبَّهُ هَانَتْ عَلَيْهِ الدُّنْيَا
textFr: Celui qui connaît son âme connaît son Seigneur, et celui qui connaît son Seigneur, ce monde lui devient insignifiant.
textEn: Whoever knows his soul knows his Lord, and whoever knows his Lord, this world becomes insignificant to him.
sourceAr: علي بن أبي طالب رضي الله عنه
sourceEn: ‘Alî ibn Abî Tâlib (may Allah be pleased with him)

textAr: إِنَّمَا يَهَابُكَ النَّاسُ عَلَى قَدْرِ هَيْبَتِكَ لِلَّهِ
textFr: Les gens ne te craignent qu'à proportion de ta crainte d'Allah.
textEn: People only fear you to the extent of your fear of Allah.
sourceEn: Al-Fudayl ibn ‘Iyâd (may Allah have mercy on him)

textAr: مَنْ كَثُرَ صَمْتُهُ كَثُرَ وَقَارُهُ
textFr: Celui dont le silence est abondant, sa dignité est grande.
textEn: Whoever's silence is abundant, his dignity is great.
sourceAr: عمر بن الخطاب رضي الله عنه
sourceEn: ‘Umar ibn al-Khattâb (may Allah be pleased with him)

textAr: مَنْ أَحَبَّ اللَّهَ أَحَبَّ اللِّقَاءَ، وَمَنْ كَرِهَ اللِّقَاءَ كَرِهَ اللَّهَ
textFr: Celui qui aime Allah aime la rencontre (avec Lui), et celui qui déteste la rencontre déteste Allah.
textEn: Whoever loves Allah loves the meeting (with Him), and whoever hates the meeting hates Allah.
sourceAr: عمر بن الخطاب رضي الله عنه
sourceEn: ‘Umar ibn al-Khattâb (may Allah be pleased with him)

textAr: لَا تَكُونُوا كَالَّذِينَ يَنْظُرُونَ إِلَى الدُّنْيَا بِأَعْيُنِ الْآخِرَةِ، وَإِلَى الْآخِرَةِ بِأَعْيُنِ الدُّنْيَا
textFr: Ne soyez pas comme ceux qui regardent ce monde avec les yeux de l'au-delà et l'au-delà avec les yeux de ce monde.
textEn: Do not be like those who look at this world with the eyes of the Hereafter and at the Hereafter with the eyes of this world.
sourceEn: Al-Hasan al-Basrî (may Allah have mercy on him)

textAr: إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُحِبُّ الْعَبْدَ الْمُتَوَاضِعَ الَّذِي لَا يَتَكَبَّرُ، وَيُبْغِضُ الْعَبْدَ الْمُتَكَبِّرَ الَّذِي لَا يَتَوَاضَعُ
textFr: Allah aime le serviteur humble qui ne s'enorgueillit pas, et Il déteste le serviteur orgueilleux qui ne s'humilie pas.
textEn: Allah loves the humble servant who does not become arrogant, and He hates the arrogant servant who does not humble himself.
sourceEn: Some of the Salaf

textAr: خَيْرُ النَّاسِ مَنْ نَفَعَ النَّاسَ
textFr: Le meilleur des gens est celui qui est utile aux gens.
textEn: The best of people is the one who benefits people.
sourceAr: عبد الله بن مسعود رضي الله عنه
sourceEn: ‘Abd Allâh ibn Mas‘ûd (may Allah be pleased with him)

textAr: مَنْ عَرَفَ رَبَّهُ هَانَتْ عَلَيْهِ الدُّنْيَا
textFr: Celui qui connaît son Seigneur, ce monde lui devient insignifiant.
textEn: Whoever knows his Lord, this world becomes insignificant to him.
sourceEn: Al-Hasan al-Basrî (may Allah have mercy on him)

textAr: إِنَّ اللَّهَ يَرْفَعُ بِالْبَلَاءِ أَقْوَامًا وَيَخْفِضُ بِالْعَافِيَةِ آخَرِينَ
textFr: Allah élève par l'épreuve certains peuples et abaisse par la santé d'autres.
textEn: Allah raises some people through affliction and lowers others through well-being.
sourceEn: Sufyân ath-Thawrî (may Allah have mercy on him)

textAr: إِنَّ الْإِيمَانَ يَزِيدُ وَيَنْقُصُ، يَزِيدُ بِالطَّاعَةِ وَيَنْقُصُ بِالْمَعْصِيَةِ
textFr: La foi augmente et diminue : elle augmente par l'obéissance et diminue par la désobéissance.
textEn: Faith increases and decreases: it increases by obedience and decreases by disobedience.
sourceEn: Some of the Salaf

textAr: لَا يَسْتَكْمِلُ عَبْدٌ حَقِيقَةَ الْإِيمَانِ حَتَّى يَكُونَ حُبُّ اللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِ أَحَبَّ إِلَيْهِ مِنْ نَفْسِهِ وَمَالِهِ وَوَلَدِهِ
textFr: Un serviteur n'atteint pas la plénitude de la foi jusqu'à ce que l'amour d'Allah et de Son Messager lui soit plus cher que lui-même, ses biens et ses enfants.
textEn: A servant does not attain the fullness of faith until the love of Allah and His Messenger is dearer to him than himself, his wealth, and his children.
sourceAr: عمر بن الخطاب رضي الله عنه
sourceEn: ‘Umar ibn al-Khattâb (may Allah be pleased with him)

textAr: مَنْ أَطَالَ الصَّمْتَ أُوتِيَ الْحِكْمَةَ
textFr: Celui qui prolonge son silence reçoit la sagesse.
textEn: Whoever prolongs his silence is given wisdom.
sourceAr: عمر بن الخطاب رضي الله عنه
sourceEn: ‘Umar ibn al-Khattâb (may Allah be pleased with him)

textAr: مَنْ أُعْجِبَ بِرَأْيِهِ ضَلَّ
textFr: Celui qui s'admire de son opinion s'égare.
textEn: Whoever is impressed by his own opinion goes astray.
sourceAr: علي بن أبي طالب رضي الله عنه
sourceEn: ‘Alî ibn Abî Tâlib (may Allah be pleased with him)

textAr: لَا تَكُونُوا عُلَمَاءَ يُشِيرُونَ بِالْخَيْرِ وَيَفْعَلُونَ الشَّرَّ
textFr: Ne soyez pas des savants qui indiquent le bien et commettent le mal.
textEn: Do not be scholars who point to good and do evil.
sourceEn: Al-Hasan al-Basrî (may Allah have mercy on him)

textAr: مَنْ عَظُمَ حِرْصُهُ عَلَى الدُّنْيَا اشْتَغَلَ بِهَا عَنِ اللَّهِ
textFr: Celui dont l'avidité pour ce monde est grande s'occupe de lui au détriment d'Allah.
textEn: Whoever's greed for this world is great is occupied with it instead of Allah.
sourceEn: Sufyân ath-Thawrî (may Allah have mercy on him)

textAr: إِذَا تَمَامُ النِّعْمَةِ عَلَى الْعَبْدِ أَنْ يَرْزُقَهُ اللَّهُ شُكْرَهَا
textFr: Le complément de la grâce sur le serviteur est qu'Allah lui accorde la reconnaissance pour elle.
textEn: The completion of the favor upon the servant is that Allah grants him gratitude for it.
sourceEn: Al-Hasan al-Basrî (may Allah have mercy on him)

textAr: لَا يَزْهَدُ فِي الدُّنْيَا إِلَّا عَارِفٌ، وَلَا يَزْهَدُ فِي الْآخِرَةِ إِلَّا جَاهِلٌ
textFr: Seul un connaisseur se détache de ce monde, et seul un ignorant se détache de l'au-delà.
textEn: Only a knower renounces this world, and only an ignorant person renounces the Hereafter.
sourceEn: Sufyân ath-Thawrî (may Allah have mercy on him)

textAr: إِنَّ اللَّهَ إِذَا أَحَبَّ عَبْدًا اسْتَعْمَلَهُ فِي عِبَادَتِهِ
textFr: Lorsqu'Allah aime un serviteur, Il l'emploie dans Son adoration.
textEn: When Allah loves a servant, He employs him in His worship.
sourceEn: Some of the Salaf

textAr: لَا يَخْفَى عَلَى اللَّهِ شَيْءٌ، وَإِنْ كَانَ فِي الْقَلْبِ
textFr: Rien n'est caché à Allah, même ce qui est dans le cœur.
textEn: Nothing is hidden from Allah, even what is in the heart.
sourceAr: عبد الله بن مسعود رضي الله عنه
sourceEn: ‘Abd Allâh ibn Mas‘ûd (may Allah be pleased with him)

textAr: مَنْ تَخَشَّعَ قَلْبُهُ خَشَعَتْ جَوَارِحُهُ
textFr: Celui dont le cœur est humble, ses membres s'humilient.
textEn: Whoever's heart is humble, his limbs become humble.
sourceEn: Sufyân ath-Thawrî (may Allah have mercy on him)

textAr: لَا يَسْتَقِيمُ إِيمَانُ عَبْدٍ حَتَّى يَسْتَقِيمَ قَلْبُهُ
textFr: La foi d'un serviteur ne se redresse pas tant que son cœur ne se redresse pas.
textEn: The faith of a servant does not become upright until his heart becomes upright.
sourceAr: عبد الله بن مسعود رضي الله عنه
sourceEn: ‘Abd Allâh ibn Mas‘ûd (may Allah be pleased with him)

textAr: مَنْ أَحَبَّ الدُّنْيَا سَقَطَ مِنْ عَيْنِ اللَّهِ
textFr: Celui qui aime ce monde tombe des yeux d'Allah.
textEn: Whoever loves this world falls from the sight of Allah.
sourceEn: Some of the Salaf

textAr: إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُحِبُّ الْعَبْدَ الَّذِي يَذْكُرُهُ فِي الْخَلَاءِ
textFr: Allah aime le serviteur qui se souvient de Lui dans l'isolement.
textEn: Allah loves the servant who remembers Him in seclusion.
sourceEn: Al-Fudayl ibn ‘Iyâd (may Allah have mercy on him)

textAr: لَا تَكُنْ مِمَّنْ يَأْمُرُ بِالْمَعْرُوفِ وَلَا يَأْتِيهِ، وَيَنْهَى عَنِ الْمُنْكَرِ وَيَأْتِيهِ
textFr: Ne sois pas de ceux qui ordonnent le bien et ne le pratiquent pas, et interdisent le mal et le commettent.
textEn: Do not be among those who enjoin good and do not do it, and forbid evil and do it.
sourceEn: Al-Hasan al-Basrî (may Allah have mercy on him)

textAr: إِنَّ الْعَبْدَ إِذَا أَخْلَصَ النِّيَّةَ وَحَسُنَ عَمَلُهُ، أَثَابَهُ اللَّهُ أَضْعَافًا
textFr: Lorsque le serviteur rend son intention sincère et que son œuvre est bonne, Allah le récompense par des multiples.
textEn: When the servant makes his intention sincere and his deed is good, Allah rewards him manifold.
sourceEn: Sufyân ath-Thawrî (may Allah have mercy on him)

textAr: رَأْسُ الدِّينِ التَّوَكُّلُ عَلَى اللَّهِ
textFr: Le commencement de la religion est la confiance en Allah.
textEn: The beginning of religion is trust in Allah.
sourceAr: عبد الله بن عباس رضي الله عنهما
sourceEn: ‘Abd Allâh ibn ‘Abbâs (may Allah be pleased with them)

textAr: مَنْ أَكَلَ حَلَالًا صَفَا قَلْبُهُ، وَمَنْ أَكَلَ حَرَامًا قَسَا قَلْبُهُ
textFr: Celui qui mange du licite a le cœur pur, et celui qui mange de l'illicite a le cœur dur.
textEn: Whoever eats lawful food has a pure heart, and whoever eats unlawful food has a hard heart.
sourceEn: Some of the Salaf

textAr: إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُجِيبُ دَعْوَةَ الْمُضْطَرِّ إِذَا دَعَاهُ
textFr: Allah répond à l'appel de celui qui est en détresse lorsqu'il L'invoque.
textEn: Allah answers the call of the distressed when he calls upon Him.
sourceAr: عبد الله بن عباس رضي الله عنهما
sourceEn: ‘Abd Allâh ibn ‘Abbâs (may Allah be pleased with them)

textAr: مَنْ حَافَظَ عَلَى الصَّلَوَاتِ نَالَ الْفَوْزَ
textFr: Celui qui préserve les prières obtient la réussite.
textEn: Whoever guards the prayers attains success.
sourceAr: عمر بن الخطاب رضي الله عنه
sourceEn: ‘Umar ibn al-Khattâb (may Allah be pleased with him)

textAr: إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُحِبُّ الْعَبْدَ النَّصُوحَ
textFr: Allah aime le serviteur sincère dans son conseil.
textEn: Allah loves the servant who is sincere in his advice.
sourceEn: Al-Hasan al-Basrî (may Allah have mercy on him)

textAr: مَنْ صَمَتَ نَجَا
textFr: Celui qui se tait est sauvé.
textEn: Whoever remains silent is saved.
sourceAr: عمر بن الخطاب رضي الله عنه
sourceEn: ‘Umar ibn al-Khattâb (may Allah be pleased with him)

textAr: مَنْ قَلَّ كَلَامُهُ دَلَّتْ فَضِيلَتُهُ
textFr: Celui dont les paroles sont rares, sa vertu est apparente.
textEn: Whoever's speech is little, his virtue is evident.
sourceAr: علي بن أبي طالب رضي الله عنه
sourceEn: ‘Alî ibn Abî Tâlib (may Allah be pleased with him)

textAr: إِنَّ اللَّهَ عِنْدَ ظَنِّ عَبْدِهِ بِهِ
textFr: Allah est comme Son serviteur Le pense.
textEn: Allah is as His servant thinks of Him.
sourceEn: Sufyân ath-Thawrî (may Allah have mercy on him)

textAr: مَنْ أَحَبَّ اللَّهَ أَحَبَّ ذِكْرَهُ
textFr: Celui qui aime Allah aime Son rappel.
textEn: Whoever loves Allah loves His remembrance.
sourceEn: Al-Hasan al-Basrî (may Allah have mercy on him)

textAr: لَا تُحِبَّ الدُّنْيَا فَتَكُونَ أَسِيرَهَا
textFr: N'aime pas ce monde, sinon tu en deviendras le prisonnier.
textEn: Do not love this world, otherwise you will become its prisoner.
sourceAr: علي بن أبي طالب رضي الله عنه
sourceEn: ‘Alî ibn Abî Tâlib (may Allah be pleased with him)

textAr: إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُحِبُّ الْعَبْدَ التَّوَّابَ
textFr: Allah aime le serviteur qui se repent beaucoup.
textEn: Allah loves the servant who repents often.
sourceAr: عبد الله بن مسعود رضي الله عنه
sourceEn: ‘Abd Allâh ibn Mas‘ûd (may Allah be pleased with him)

textAr: مَنْ تَرَكَ الدُّنْيَا أَحَبَّتْهُ الْآخِرَةُ
textFr: Celui qui abandonne ce monde est aimé de l'au-delà.
textEn: Whoever abandons this world is loved by the Hereafter.
sourceEn: Sufyân ath-Thawrî (may Allah have mercy on him)

textAr: إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يَقْبَلُ عَمَلًا إِلَّا بِالْإِخْلَاصِ
textFr: Allah n'accepte aucune œuvre sans sincérité.
textEn: Allah does not accept any deed without sincerity.
sourceEn: Al-Hasan al-Basrî (may Allah have mercy on him)

textAr: لَا يَزَالُ الْعَبْدُ خَيْرًا مَا أَكْرَمَ نَفْسَهُ، وَإِذَا أَهَانَهَا هَلَكَ
textFr: Le serviteur reste bon tant qu'il honore son âme, et s'il l'avilit, il périt.
textEn: The servant remains good as long as he honors his soul, and if he debases it, he perishes.
sourceAr: عمر بن الخطاب رضي الله عنه
sourceEn: ‘Umar ibn al-Khattâb (may Allah be pleased with him)

textAr: مَنْ كَثُرَ تَفَكُّرُهُ فِي الْآخِرَةِ قَلَّ طَمَعُهُ فِي الدُّنْيَا
textFr: Celui qui médite beaucoup sur l'au-delà voit son avidité pour ce monde diminuer.
textEn: Whoever reflects much on the Hereafter, his greed for this world decreases.
sourceEn: Al-Hasan al-Basrî (may Allah have mercy on him)

textAr: إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُحِبُّ الْعَبْدَ الْغَنِيَّ الْحَلِيمَ
textFr: Allah aime le serviteur riche (de cœur) et clément.
textEn: Allah loves the servant who is rich (of heart) and clement.
sourceEn: Al-Fudayl ibn ‘Iyâd (may Allah have mercy on him)

textAr: لَا تَدَعْ عَمَلًا صَالِحًا لِعَمَلٍ صَالِحٍ آخَرَ، فَإِنَّ الْأَوَّلَ قَدْ يَكُونُ أَفْضَلَ
textFr: N'abandonne pas une bonne œuvre pour une autre bonne œuvre, car la première pourrait être meilleure.
textEn: Do not abandon a good deed for another good deed, for the first might be better.
sourceEn: Some of the Salaf

textAr: مَنْ أَحْيَا قَلْبَهُ بِالْعِلْمِ، مَاتَتْ شَهْوَتُهُ عَلَى الدُّنْيَا
textFr: Celui qui fait vivre son cœur par la science, sa passion pour ce monde meurt.
textEn: Whoever gives life to his heart with knowledge, his desire for this world dies.
sourceEn: Sufyân ath-Thawrî (may Allah have mercy on him)

textAr: لَا يَكُنْ أَحَبُّ شَيْءٍ إِلَيْكَ الدُّنْيَا، فَإِنَّهَا لَيْسَتْ بِدَارِ بَقَاءٍ
textFr: Que ce monde ne soit pas la chose la plus aimée de toi, car il n'est pas une demeure éternelle.
textEn: Do not let this world be the most beloved thing to you, for it is not an abode of permanence.
sourceAr: علي بن أبي طالب رضي الله عنه
sourceEn: ‘Alî ibn Abî Tâlib (may Allah be pleased with him)

textAr: إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُجِيبُ الدَّاعِيَ إِذَا دَعَاهُ مِنْ قَلْبٍ سَلِيمٍ
textFr: Allah répond à celui qui L'invoque d'un cœur sain.
textEn: Allah answers the one who calls upon Him with a sound heart.
sourceAr: عبد الله بن عباس رضي الله عنهما
sourceEn: ‘Abd Allâh ibn ‘Abbâs (may Allah be pleased with them)

textAr: مَنْ تَزَوَّدَ بِالتَّقْوَى سَلِمَ مِنَ الْبَلَاءِ
textFr: Celui qui se pourvoit de piété est préservé de l'épreuve.
textEn: Whoever takes piety as provision is saved from affliction.
sourceEn: Al-Hasan al-Basrî (may Allah have mercy on him)

textAr: إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُحِبُّ الْعَبْدَ الَّذِي يَخْشَاهُ فِي الْخَلَاءِ
textFr: Allah aime le serviteur qui Le craint dans l'isolement.
textEn: Allah loves the servant who fears Him in seclusion.
sourceEn: Al-Fudayl ibn ‘Iyâd (may Allah have mercy on him)

textAr: لَا تُطِيعُوا النَّفْسَ فِي شَهْوَاتِهَا، فَإِنَّهَا تَدْعُو إِلَى الْهَلَاكِ
textFr: N'obéis pas à l'âme dans ses passions, car elle appelle à la perdition.
textEn: Do not obey the soul in its desires, for it calls to destruction.
sourceEn: Sufyân ath-Thawrî (may Allah have mercy on him)

textAr: مَنْ أَكْثَرَ ذِكْرَ الْمَوْتِ قَلَّ فَرَحُهُ بِالدُّنْيَا
textFr: Celui qui multiplie le souvenir de la mort voit sa joie pour ce monde diminuer.
textEn: Whoever frequently remembers death, his joy in this world decreases.
sourceEn: Al-Hasan al-Basrî (may Allah have mercy on him)

textAr: إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُحِبُّ الْعَبْدَ الَّذِي يُسَامِحُ النَّاسَ
textFr: Allah aime le serviteur qui pardonne aux gens.
textEn: Allah loves the servant who forgives people.
sourceAr: عمر بن الخطاب رضي الله عنه
sourceEn: ‘Umar ibn al-Khattâb (may Allah be pleased with him)

textAr: لَا تَكُونُوا مِمَّنْ يَشْتَرِي الدُّنْيَا بِالْآخِرَةِ
textFr: Ne soyez pas de ceux qui achètent ce monde au prix de l'au-delà.
textEn: Do not be among those who buy this world at the price of the Hereafter.
sourceAr: علي بن أبي طالب رضي الله عنه
sourceEn: ‘Alî ibn Abî Tâlib (may Allah be pleased with him)

textAr: مَنْ رَضِيَ بِاللَّهِ رَبًّا وَبِالْإِسْلَامِ دِينًا وَبِمُحَمَّدٍ نَبِيًّا، دَخَلَ الْجَنَّةَ
textFr: Celui qui se satisfait d'Allah comme Seigneur, de l'Islam comme religion et de Muhammad comme Prophète, entre au Paradis.
textEn: Whoever is content with Allah as Lord, Islam as religion, and Muhammad as Prophet, enters Paradise.
sourceAr: عبد الله بن مسعود رضي الله عنه
sourceEn: ‘Abd Allâh ibn Mas‘ûd (may Allah be pleased with him)

textAr: إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُحِبُّ الْعَبْدَ الَّذِي يُقِيمُ الصَّلَاةَ فِي وَقْتِهَا
textFr: Allah aime le serviteur qui accomplit la prière à son heure.
textEn: Allah loves the servant who performs the prayer at its time.
sourceAr: عمر بن الخطاب رضي الله عنه
sourceEn: ‘Umar ibn al-Khattâb (may Allah be pleased with him)

textAr: لَا تَكُنْ عَبْدَ الشَّهْوَةِ فَتَكُونَ أَرْذَلَ الْعَبِيدِ
textFr: Ne sois pas l'esclave de la passion, sinon tu seras le plus vil des esclaves.
textEn: Do not be a slave of desire, otherwise you will be the most despicable of slaves.
sourceEn: Some of the Salaf

textAr: مَنْ خَافَ اللَّهَ خَافَهُ كُلُّ شَيْءٍ
textFr: Celui qui craint Allah, toute chose Le craint.
textEn: Whoever fears Allah, everything fears him.
sourceEn: Sufyân ath-Thawrî (may Allah have mercy on him)

textAr: إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُحِبُّ الْعَبْدَ الَّذِي يَصْلُحُ فِي سِرِّهِ وَعَلَانِيَتِهِ
textFr: Allah aime le serviteur qui est bon dans son secret et en public.
textEn: Allah loves the servant who is good in private and in public.
sourceEn: Al-Hasan al-Basrî (may Allah have mercy on him)

textAr: لَا تَجْعَلُوا لِأَنْفُسِكُمْ حَظًّا فِي الدُّنْيَا أَكْثَرَ مِنْ حَظِّهَا فِي الْآخِرَةِ
textFr: Ne donnez pas à vous-mêmes une part dans ce monde plus grande que votre part dans l'au-delà.
textEn: Do not give yourselves a share in this world greater than your share in the Hereafter.
sourceAr: علي بن أبي طالب رضي الله عنه
sourceEn: ‘Alî ibn Abî Tâlib (may Allah be pleased with him)

textAr: مَنْ عَمِلَ لِلَّهِ أَعْطَاهُ اللَّهُ فَوْقَ مَا يَطْلُبُ
textFr: Celui qui œuvre pour Allah, Allah lui donne plus qu'il ne demande.
textEn: Whoever works for Allah, Allah gives him more than he asks.
sourceEn: Sufyân ath-Thawrî (may Allah have mercy on him)

textAr: إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُحِبُّ الْعَبْدَ الَّذِي يَصْبِرُ عَلَى الْأَذَى
textFr: Allah aime le serviteur qui endure la nuisance.
textEn: Allah loves the servant who endures harm.
sourceAr: عمر بن الخطاب رضي الله عنه
sourceEn: ‘Umar ibn al-Khattâb (may Allah be pleased with him)

textAr: لَا تَكُنْ مِمَّنْ يَشْكُو النَّاسَ إِلَى اللَّهِ وَلَا يَشْكُو نَفْسَهُ إِلَى اللَّهِ
