textFr: Ne sois pas de ceux qui se plaignent des gens à Allah sans se plaindre d'eux-mêmes à Allah.
textEn: Do not be among those who complain about people to Allah without complaining about themselves to Allah.
sourceEn: Al-Hasan al-Basrî (may Allah have mercy on him)

textAr: مَنْ تَذَكَّرَ الْمَوْتَ نَسِيَ الدُّنْيَا
textFr: Celui qui se souvient de la mort oublie ce monde.
textEn: Whoever remembers death forgets this world.
sourceAr: عبد الله بن مسعود رضي الله عنه
sourceEn: ‘Abd Allâh ibn Mas‘ûd (may Allah be pleased with him)

textAr: إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُحِبُّ الْعَبْدَ الَّذِي يَتَوَاضَعُ لِلَّهِ
textFr: Allah aime le serviteur qui s'humilie devant Lui.
textEn: Allah loves the servant who humbles himself before Him.
sourceEn: Al-Fudayl ibn ‘Iyâd (may Allah have mercy on him)

textAr: لَا تَكُونُوا كَالَّذِينَ نَسُوا اللَّهَ فَأَنْسَاهُمْ أَنْفُسَهُمْ
textFr: Ne soyez pas comme ceux qui ont oublié Allah, alors Il leur a fait oublier eux-mêmes.
textEn: Do not be like those who forgot Allah, so He made them forget themselves.
sourceEn: Al-Hasan al-Basrî (may Allah have mercy on him)

textAr: مَنْ حَافَظَ عَلَى ذِكْرِ اللَّهِ، حَفِظَهُ اللَّهُ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ
textFr: Celui qui préserve le rappel d'Allah, Allah le préserve dans ce monde et dans l'au-delà.
textEn: Whoever preserves the remembrance of Allah, Allah preserves him in this world and the Hereafter.
sourceEn: Sufyân ath-Thawrî (may Allah have mercy on him)

textAr: إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُحِبُّ الْعَبْدَ الَّذِي يَغْضَبُ لِلَّهِ
textFr: Allah aime le serviteur qui se met en colère pour Allah.
textEn: Allah loves the servant who gets angry for Allah.
sourceAr: عبد الله بن عباس رضي الله عنهما
sourceEn: ‘Abd Allâh ibn ‘Abbâs (may Allah be pleased with them)

textAr: لَا تَكُنْ مِمَّنْ يَعْمَلُ لِلدُّنْيَا وَيَتْرُكُ الْآخِرَةَ
textFr: Ne sois pas de ceux qui œuvrent pour ce monde et abandonnent l'au-delà.
textEn: Do not be among those who work for this world and abandon the Hereafter.
sourceAr: علي بن أبي طالب رضي الله عنه
sourceEn: ‘Alî ibn Abî Tâlib (may Allah be pleased with him)

textAr: مَنْ أَسَرَّ السَّرِيرَةَ أَظْهَرَهَا اللَّهُ
textFr: Celui qui cache un secret, Allah le manifestera.
textEn: Whoever conceals a secret, Allah will expose it.
sourceEn: Al-Hasan al-Basrî (may Allah have mercy on him)

textAr: إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُحِبُّ الْعَبْدَ الَّذِي يُطْعِمُ الْجَائِعَ
textFr: Allah aime le serviteur qui nourrit l'affamé.
textEn: Allah loves the servant who feeds the hungry.
sourceAr: عمر بن الخطاب رضي الله عنه
sourceEn: ‘Umar ibn al-Khattâb (may Allah be pleased with him)

textAr: لَا تَكُونُوا مِمَّنْ يَخْشَى النَّاسَ فِي اللَّهِ
textFr: Ne soyez pas de ceux qui craignent les gens au sujet d'Allah.
textEn: Do not be among those who fear people regarding Allah.
sourceEn: Some of the Salaf

textAr: مَنْ رَضِيَ بِالْقَضَاءِ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ
textFr: Celui qui se satisfait du décret, Allah est satisfait de lui.
textEn: Whoever is content with the decree, Allah is content with him.
sourceEn: Sufyân ath-Thawrî (may Allah have mercy on him)

textAr: إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُحِبُّ الْعَبْدَ الَّذِي يُصْلِحُ بَيْنَ النَّاسِ
textFr: Allah aime le serviteur qui réconcilie les gens.
textEn: Allah loves the servant who reconciles people.
sourceAr: عبد الله بن مسعود رضي الله عنه
sourceEn: ‘Abd Allâh ibn Mas‘ûd (may Allah be pleased with him)

textAr: لَا تَكُنْ مِمَّنْ يُحِبُّ الْفَضَائِلَ وَلَا يَعْمَلُ بِهَا
textFr: Ne sois pas de ceux qui aiment les vertus sans les pratiquer.
textEn: Do not be among those who love virtues without practicing them.
sourceEn: Al-Hasan al-Basrî (may Allah have mercy on him)

textAr: مَنْ أَكْثَرَ ذِكْرَ اللَّهِ، أَحَبَّهُ اللَّهُ
textFr: Celui qui multiplie le rappel d'Allah, Allah l'aime.
textEn: Whoever multiplies the remembrance of Allah, Allah loves him.
sourceAr: عمر بن الخطاب رضي الله عنه
sourceEn: ‘Umar ibn al-Khattâb (may Allah be pleased with him)

textAr: إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُحِبُّ الْعَبْدَ الَّذِي يَتَوَكَّلُ عَلَيْهِ
textFr: Allah aime le serviteur qui place sa confiance en Lui.
textEn: Allah loves the servant who puts his trust in Him.
sourceAr: علي بن أبي طالب رضي الله عنه
sourceEn: ‘Alî ibn Abî Tâlib (may Allah be pleased with him)

textAr: لَا تَكُونُوا مِمَّنْ يَذْكُرُ اللَّهَ فِي الْخَلَاءِ وَيَنْسَاهُ فِي الْمَلَأِ
textFr: Ne soyez pas de ceux qui mentionnent Allah en privé et L'oublient en public.
textEn: Do not be among those who mention Allah in private and forget Him in public.
sourceEn: Al-Hasan al-Basrî (may Allah have mercy on him)

textAr: مَنْ عَمِلَ سَيِّئَةً فَلْيَتْبَعْهَا بِحَسَنَةٍ تَمْحُهَا
textFr: Celui qui commet un péché, qu'il le suive d'une bonne action qui l'efface.
textEn: Whoever commits a sin, let him follow it with a good deed that erases it.
sourceAr: عبد الله بن مسعود رضي الله عنه
sourceEn: ‘Abd Allâh ibn Mas‘ûd (may Allah be pleased with him)

textAr: إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُحِبُّ الْعَبْدَ الَّذِي يُحْسِنُ الْعِبَادَةَ
textFr: Allah aime le serviteur qui pratique bien l'adoration.
textEn: Allah loves the servant who performs worship well.
sourceEn: Sufyân ath-Thawrî (may Allah have mercy on him)

textAr: لَا تَكُنْ مِمَّنْ يَأْكُلُ الْحَلَالَ وَيَشْرَبُ الْحَلَالَ وَيَعْمَلُ الْحَرَامَ
textFr: Ne sois pas de ceux qui mangent du licite, boivent du licite et commettent l'illicite.
textEn: Do not be among those who eat lawful food, drink lawful drink, and commit unlawful deeds.
sourceEn: Al-Hasan al-Basrî (may Allah have mercy on him)

textAr: مَنْ أَحَبَّ اللَّهَ أَحَبَّ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ لِلَّهِ
textFr: Celui qui aime Allah aime toute chose pour Allah.
textEn: Whoever loves Allah loves everything for Allah.
sourceAr: عمر بن الخطاب رضي الله عنه
sourceEn: ‘Umar ibn al-Khattâb (may Allah be pleased with him)

textAr: إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُحِبُّ الْعَبْدَ الَّذِي يَصُومُ فِي الْحَرِّ
textFr: Allah aime le serviteur qui jeûne en période de chaleur.
textEn: Allah loves the servant who fasts in the heat.
sourceEn: Some of the Salaf

textAr: لَا تَكُونُوا مِمَّنْ يَخْشَى النَّاسَ فِي الْحَقِّ
textFr: Ne soyez pas de ceux qui craignent les gens dans la vérité.
textEn: Do not be among those who fear people in truth.
sourceAr: علي بن أبي طالب رضي الله عنه
sourceEn: ‘Alî ibn Abî Tâlib (may Allah be pleased with him)

textAr: مَنْ صَبَرَ عَلَى الْبَلَاءِ نَالَ الرِّضَا
textFr: Celui qui endure l'épreuve atteint la satisfaction (d'Allah).
textEn: Whoever endures affliction attains contentment.
sourceEn: Sufyân ath-Thawrî (may Allah have mercy on him)

textAr: إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُحِبُّ الْعَبْدَ الَّذِي يُؤْثِرُ الْآخِرَةَ عَلَى الدُّنْيَا
textFr: Allah aime le serviteur qui préfère l'au-delà à ce monde.
textEn: Allah loves the servant who prefers the Hereafter over this world.
sourceAr: عبد الله بن مسعود رضي الله عنه
sourceEn: ‘Abd Allâh ibn Mas‘ûd (may Allah be pleased with him)

textAr: لَا تَكُنْ مِمَّنْ يَطْلُبُ الدُّنْيَا وَيَتْرُكُ الْآخِرَةَ
textFr: Ne sois pas de ceux qui recherchent ce monde et abandonnent l'au-delà.
textEn: Do not be among those who seek this world and abandon the Hereafter.
sourceEn: Al-Hasan al-Basrî (may Allah have mercy on him)

textAr: مَنْ تَوَاضَعَ لِلَّهِ رَفَعَهُ اللَّهُ
textFr: Celui qui s'humilie devant Allah, Allah l'élève.
textEn: Whoever humbles himself before Allah, Allah raises him.
sourceAr: عمر بن الخطاب رضي الله عنه
sourceEn: ‘Umar ibn al-Khattâb (may Allah be pleased with him)

textAr: إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُحِبُّ الْعَبْدَ الَّذِي يَسْتَغْفِرُ كَثِيرًا
textFr: Allah aime le serviteur qui demande pardon fréquemment.
textEn: Allah loves the servant who asks for forgiveness often.
sourceEn: Al-Fudayl ibn ‘Iyâd (may Allah have mercy on him)

textAr: لَا تَكُونُوا مِمَّنْ يَأْمُرُ بِالْمَعْرُوفِ وَيَنْسَى نَفْسَهُ
textFr: Ne soyez pas de ceux qui ordonnent le bien et s'oublient eux-mêmes.
textEn: Do not be among those who enjoin good and forget themselves.
sourceAr: علي بن أبي طالب رضي الله عنه
sourceEn: ‘Alî ibn Abî Tâlib (may Allah be pleased with him)

textAr: مَنْ حَافَظَ عَلَى الْفَرَائِضِ نَالَ الْجَنَّةَ
textFr: Celui qui préserve les obligations atteint le Paradis.
textEn: Whoever preserves the obligations attains Paradise.
sourceAr: عبد الله بن مسعود رضي الله عنه
sourceEn: ‘Abd Allâh ibn Mas‘ûd (may Allah be pleased with him)

textAr: إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُحِبُّ الْعَبْدَ الَّذِي يَصْبِرُ عَلَى الْفَقْرِ
textFr: Allah aime le serviteur qui endure la pauvreté.
textEn: Allah loves the servant who endures poverty.
sourceEn: Al-Hasan al-Basrî (may Allah have mercy on him)

textAr: لَا تَكُنْ مِمَّنْ يَغْتَابُ النَّاسَ وَيَنْسَى عُيُوبَ نَفْسِهِ
textFr: Ne sois pas de ceux qui médissent des gens et oublient leurs propres défauts.
textEn: Do not be among those who backbite people and forget their own faults.
sourceEn: Sufyân ath-Thawrî (may Allah have mercy on him)

textAr: مَنْ عَمِلَ بِالْإِخْلَاصِ نَالَ الْقُبُولَ
textFr: Celui qui œuvre avec sincérité obtient l'acceptation.
textEn: Whoever works with sincerity attains acceptance.
sourceAr: عمر بن الخطاب رضي الله عنه
sourceEn: ‘Umar ibn al-Khattâb (may Allah be pleased with him)

textAr: إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُحِبُّ الْعَبْدَ الَّذِي يُكْثِرُ الصَّلَاةَ
textFr: Allah aime le serviteur qui multiplie la prière.
textEn: Allah loves the servant who multiplies the prayer.
sourceAr: علي بن أبي طالب رضي الله عنه
sourceEn: ‘Alî ibn Abî Tâlib (may Allah be pleased with him)

textAr: لَا تَكُونُوا مِمَّنْ يَخْشَى الْفَقْرَ وَيَأْمَنُ الْغِنَى
textFr: Ne soyez pas de ceux qui craignent la pauvreté et se sentent en sécurité dans la richesse.
textEn: Do not be among those who fear poverty and feel secure in wealth.
sourceEn: Al-Hasan al-Basrî (may Allah have mercy on him)

textAr: مَنْ تَرَكَ الدُّنْيَا أَحَبَّتْهُ الْآخِرَةُ
textFr: Celui qui abandonne ce monde est aimé de l'au-delà.
textEn: Whoever abandons this world is loved by the Hereafter.
sourceEn: Sufyân ath-Thawrî (may Allah have mercy on him)

textAr: إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُحِبُّ الْعَبْدَ الَّذِي يُحْسِنُ الظَّنَّ بِاللَّهِ
textFr: Allah aime le serviteur qui a une bonne opinion d'Allah.
textEn: Allah loves the servant who has a good opinion of Allah.
sourceAr: عبد الله بن مسعود رضي الله عنه
sourceEn: ‘Abd Allâh ibn Mas‘ûd (may Allah be pleased with him)

textAr: لَا تَكُنْ مِمَّنْ يَدْعُو اللَّهَ فِي الشِّدَّةِ وَيَنْسَاهُ فِي الرَّخَاءِ
textFr: Ne sois pas de ceux qui invoquent Allah dans l'adversité et L'oublient dans l'aisance.
textEn: Do not be among those who call upon Allah in hardship and forget Him in ease.
sourceAr: عمر بن الخطاب رضي الله عنه
sourceEn: ‘Umar ibn al-Khattâb (may Allah be pleased with him)

textAr: مَنْ صَبَرَ عَلَى الْجُوعِ نَالَ الشِّبَعَ فِي الْآخِرَةِ
textFr: Celui qui endure la faim obtient la satiété dans l'au-delà.
textEn: Whoever endures hunger attains satiety in the Hereafter.
sourceEn: Al-Hasan al-Basrî (may Allah have mercy on him)

textAr: إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُحِبُّ الْعَبْدَ الَّذِي يُحْيِي اللَّيْلَ بِالصَّلَاةِ
textFr: Allah aime le serviteur qui vivifie la nuit par la prière.
textEn: Allah loves the servant who enlivens the night with prayer.
sourceAr: علي بن أبي طالب رضي الله عنه
sourceEn: ‘Alî ibn Abî Tâlib (may Allah be pleased with him)

textAr: لَا تَكُونُوا مِمَّنْ يَضْحَكُ كَثِيرًا وَيَبْكِي قَلِيلًا
textFr: Ne soyez pas de ceux qui rient beaucoup et pleurent peu.
textEn: Do not be among those who laugh a lot and cry little.
sourceEn: Sufyân ath-Thawrî (may Allah have mercy on him)

textAr: مَنْ أَحْسَنَ الصَّلَاةَ فِي الدُّنْيَا نَالَ الْفَوْزَ فِي الْآخِرَةِ
textFr: Celui qui fait bien la prière dans ce monde obtient la réussite dans l'au-delà.
textEn: Whoever performs the prayer well in this world attains success in the Hereafter.
sourceAr: عبد الله بن مسعود رضي الله عنه
sourceEn: ‘Abd Allâh ibn Mas‘ûd (may Allah be pleased with him)

textAr: إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُحِبُّ الْعَبْدَ الَّذِي يَذْكُرُ اللَّهَ فِي أَسْوَاقِهِ
textFr: Allah aime le serviteur qui mentionne Allah dans ses marchés.
textEn: Allah loves the servant who mentions Allah in his markets.
sourceEn: Some of the Salaf

textAr: لَا تَكُنْ مِمَّنْ يَشْهَدُ الزُّورَ وَيَكْتُمُ الْحَقَّ
textFr: Ne sois pas de ceux qui témoignent faussement et cachent la vérité.
textEn: Do not be among those who bear false witness and conceal the truth.
sourceAr: عمر بن الخطاب رضي الله عنه
sourceEn: ‘Umar ibn al-Khattâb (may Allah be pleased with him)

textAr: مَنْ تَابَ إِلَى اللَّهِ تَابَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ
textFr: Celui qui se repent à Allah, Allah se repent envers lui.
textEn: Whoever repents to Allah, Allah turns to him.
sourceAr: علي بن أبي طالب رضي الله عنه
sourceEn: ‘Alî ibn Abî Tâlib (may Allah be pleased with him)

textAr: إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُحِبُّ الْعَبْدَ الَّذِي يَخْشَاهُ فِي السِّرِّ
textFr: Allah aime le serviteur qui Le craint en secret.
textEn: Allah loves the servant who fears Him in secret.
sourceEn: Al-Hasan al-Basrî (may Allah have mercy on him)

textAr: لَا تَكُونُوا مِمَّنْ يَأْكُلُ الْحَرَامَ وَيَشْرَبُ الْحَرَامَ
textFr: Ne soyez pas de ceux qui mangent de l'illicite et boivent de l'illicite.
textEn: Do not be among those who eat unlawful food and drink unlawful drink.
sourceEn: Sufyân ath-Thawrî (may Allah have mercy on him)

textAr: مَنْ صَبَرَ عَلَى الْعُزْلَةِ سَلِمَ دِينُهُ
textFr: Celui qui endure la solitude préserve sa religion.
textEn: Whoever endures solitude preserves his religion.
sourceAr: عبد الله بن مسعود رضي الله عنه
sourceEn: ‘Abd Allâh ibn Mas‘ûd (may Allah be pleased with him)

textAr: إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُحِبُّ الْعَبْدَ الَّذِي يُؤْتِي الزَّكَاةَ بِرِضَا نَفْسٍ
textFr: Allah aime le serviteur qui donne la zakat de bon gré.
textEn: Allah loves the servant who gives zakat willingly.
sourceAr: عمر بن الخطاب رضي الله عنه
sourceEn: ‘Umar ibn al-Khattâb (may Allah be pleased with him)

textAr: لَا تَكُنْ مِمَّنْ يَحْفَظُ الْقُرْآنَ وَلَا يَعْمَلُ بِهِ
textFr: Ne sois pas de ceux qui mémorisent le Coran sans le pratiquer.
textEn: Do not be among those who memorize the Quran without practicing it.
sourceAr: علي بن أبي طالب رضي الله عنه
sourceEn: ‘Alî ibn Abî Tâlib (may Allah be pleased with him)

textAr: مَنْ تَرَكَ الْمَعَاصِيَ نَالَ الرِّضْوَانَ
textFr: Celui qui abandonne les désobéissances obtient l'agrément.
textEn: Whoever abandons disobedience attains pleasure.
sourceEn: Al-Hasan al-Basrî (may Allah have mercy on him)

textAr: إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُحِبُّ الْعَبْدَ الَّذِي يَصُومُ النَّهَارَ وَيَقُومُ اللَّيْلَ
textFr: Allah aime le serviteur qui jeûne le jour et prie la nuit.
textEn: Allah loves the servant who fasts during the day and prays at night.
sourceEn: Sufyân ath-Thawrî (may Allah have mercy on him)

textAr: لَا تَكُونُوا مِمَّنْ يَكْتُمُ الْعِلْمَ وَيُضِلُّ النَّاسَ
textFr: Ne soyez pas de ceux qui cachent la science et égarent les gens.
textEn: Do not be among those who conceal knowledge and mislead people.
sourceAr: عبد الله بن مسعود رضي الله عنه
sourceEn: ‘Abd Allâh ibn Mas‘ûd (may Allah be pleased with him)

textAr: مَنْ أَحَبَّ اللَّهَ أَحَبَّ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ
textFr: Celui qui aime Allah aime les croyants.
textEn: Whoever loves Allah loves the believers.
sourceAr: عمر بن الخطاب رضي الله عنه
sourceEn: ‘Umar ibn al-Khattâb (may Allah be pleased with him)

textAr: إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُحِبُّ الْعَبْدَ الَّذِي يَغْفِرُ لِلنَّاسِ
textFr: Allah aime le serviteur qui pardonne aux gens.
textEn: Allah loves the servant who forgives people.
sourceAr: علي بن أبي طالب رضي الله عنه
sourceEn: ‘Alî ibn Abî Tâlib (may Allah be pleased with him)

textAr: لَا تَكُنْ مِمَّنْ يَكْذِبُ كَثِيرًا فَيَفْقِدُ الصِّدْقَ
textFr: Ne sois pas de ceux qui mentent beaucoup et perdent la véracité.
textEn: Do not be among those who lie a lot and lose truthfulness.
sourceEn: Al-Hasan al-Basrî (may Allah have mercy on him)

textAr: مَنْ صَبَرَ عَلَى الْأَذَى نَالَ الْعَافِيَةَ
textFr: Celui qui endure la nuisance obtient la santé.
textEn: Whoever endures harm attains well-being.
sourceEn: Sufyân ath-Thawrî (may Allah have mercy on him)

textAr: إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُحِبُّ الْعَبْدَ الَّذِي يَشْكُرُ اللَّهَ عَلَى نِعَمِهِ
textFr: Allah aime le serviteur qui remercie Allah pour Ses bienfaits.
textEn: Allah loves the servant who thanks Allah for His favors.
sourceAr: عبد الله بن مسعود رضي الله عنه
sourceEn: ‘Abd Allâh ibn Mas‘ûd (may Allah be pleased with him)

textAr: لَا تَكُونُوا مِمَّنْ يَذْكُرُ اللَّهَ قَلِيلًا وَيَكْثُرُ الْغَفْلَةَ
textFr: Ne soyez pas de ceux qui mentionnent Allah rarement et s'abandonnent à l'insouciance.
textEn: Do not be among those who mention Allah rarely and are heedless.
sourceAr: عمر بن الخطاب رضي الله عنه
sourceEn: ‘Umar ibn al-Khattâb (may Allah be pleased with him)

textAr: مَنْ تَرَكَ الْكِبْرَ نَالَ التَّوَاضُعَ
textFr: Celui qui abandonne l'orgueil obtient l'humilité.
textEn: Whoever abandons pride attains humility.
sourceAr: علي بن أبي طالب رضي الله عنه
sourceEn: ‘Alî ibn Abî Tâlib (may Allah be pleased with him)

textAr: إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُحِبُّ الْعَبْدَ الَّذِي يُحْسِنُ الْخُلُقَ
textFr: Allah aime le serviteur qui a une bonne moralité.
textEn: Allah loves the servant who has good character.
sourceEn: Al-Hasan al-Basrî (may Allah have mercy on him)

textAr: لَا تَكُنْ مِمَّنْ يَخْشَى النَّاسَ فِي الْأَمْرِ بِالْمَعْرُوفِ
textFr: Ne sois pas de ceux qui craignent les gens dans l'ordre du bien.
textEn: Do not be among those who fear people in enjoining good.
sourceEn: Sufyân ath-Thawrî (may Allah have mercy on him)

textAr: مَنْ صَبَرَ عَلَى الْحِرْمَانِ نَالَ الْإِحْسَانَ
textFr: Celui qui endure la privation obtient la bienfaisance.
textEn: Whoever endures deprivation attains benevolence.
sourceAr: عبد الله بن مسعود رضي الله عنه
sourceEn: ‘Abd Allâh ibn Mas‘ûd (may Allah be pleased with him)

textAr: إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُحِبُّ الْعَبْدَ الَّذِي يَعْمَلُ الْخَيْرَ بِإِخْلَاصٍ
textFr: Allah aime le serviteur qui fait le bien avec sincérité.
textEn: Allah loves the servant who does good with sincerity.
sourceAr: عمر بن الخطاب رضي الله عنه
sourceEn: ‘Umar ibn al-Khattâb (may Allah be pleased with him)

textAr: لَا تَكُونُوا مِمَّنْ يَخْشَى الْفَقْرَ وَيَتَّكِلُ عَلَى الْغَيْرِ
textFr: Ne soyez pas de ceux qui craignent la pauvreté et s'appuient sur autrui.
textEn: Do not be among those who fear poverty and rely on others.
sourceAr: علي بن أبي طالب رضي الله عنه
sourceEn: ‘Alî ibn Abî Tâlib (may Allah be pleased with him)

textAr: مَنْ تَرَكَ الرِّيَاءَ نَالَ الْإِخْلَاصَ
textFr: Celui qui abandonne l'ostentation obtient la sincérité.
textEn: Whoever abandons showing off attains sincerity.
sourceEn: Al-Hasan al-Basrî (may Allah have mercy on him)

textAr: إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُحِبُّ الْعَبْدَ الَّذِي يَتَصَدَّقُ سِرًّا
textFr: Allah aime le serviteur qui fait l'aumône en secret.
textEn: Allah loves the servant who gives charity in secret.
sourceEn: Sufyân ath-Thawrî (may Allah have mercy on him)

textAr: لَا تَكُنْ مِمَّنْ يَضْحَكُ كَثِيرًا فَيَمُوتُ قَلْبُهُ
textFr: Ne sois pas de ceux qui rient beaucoup, car leur cœur meurt.
textEn: Do not be among those who laugh a lot, for their heart dies.
sourceAr: عبد الله بن مسعود رضي الله عنه
sourceEn: ‘Abd Allâh ibn Mas‘ûd (may Allah be pleased with him)

textAr: مَنْ أَحْيَا لَيْلَهُ بِالصَّلَاةِ نَالَ النُّورَ
textFr: Celui qui vivifie sa nuit par la prière obtient la lumière.
textEn: Whoever enlivens his night with prayer attains light.
sourceAr: عمر بن الخطاب رضي الله عنه
sourceEn: ‘Umar ibn al-Khattâb (may Allah be pleased with him)

textAr: إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُحِبُّ الْعَبْدَ الَّذِي يُحَافِظُ عَلَى الصَّلَاةِ فِي وَقْتِهَا
textFr: Allah aime le serviteur qui préserve la prière à son heure.
textEn: Allah loves the servant who preserves the prayer at its time.
sourceAr: علي بن أبي طالب رضي الله عنه
sourceEn: ‘Alî ibn Abî Tâlib (may Allah be pleased with him)

textAr: لَا تَكُونُوا مِمَّنْ يَأْكُلُ الْحَلَالَ وَيَشْرَبُ الْحَلَالَ وَيَلْبَسُ الْحَلَالَ وَيَتَكَلَّمُ بِالْحَرَامِ
textFr: Ne soyez pas de ceux qui mangent du licite, boivent du licite, s'habillent de licite et parlent d'illicite.
textEn: Do not be among those who eat lawful food, drink lawful drink, wear lawful clothes, and speak unlawfully.
sourceEn: Al-Hasan al-Basrî (may Allah have mercy on him)

textAr: مَنْ تَرَكَ الْغِيبَةَ نَالَ الْعِزَّةَ
textFr: Celui qui abandonne la médisance obtient la dignité.
textEn: Whoever abandons backbiting attains honor.
sourceEn: Sufyân ath-Thawrî (may Allah have mercy on him)

textAr: إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُحِبُّ الْعَبْدَ الَّذِي يَصِلُ الرَّحِمَ
textFr: Allah aime le serviteur qui entretient les liens de parenté.
textEn: Allah loves the servant who maintains family ties.
sourceAr: عبد الله بن مسعود رضي الله عنه
sourceEn: ‘Abd Allâh ibn Mas‘ûd (may Allah be pleased with him)

textAr: لَا تَكُنْ مِمَّنْ يَكْذِبُ فِي الْحَدِيثِ
textFr: Ne sois pas de ceux qui mentent dans leur propos.
textEn: Do not be among those who lie in their speech.
sourceAr: عمر بن الخطاب رضي الله عنه
sourceEn: ‘Umar ibn al-Khattâb (may Allah be pleased with him)

textAr: مَنْ صَبَرَ عَلَى الْبَلَاءِ نَالَ الثَّوَابَ
textFr: Celui qui endure l'épreuve obtient la récompense.
textEn: Whoever endures affliction attains reward.
sourceAr: علي بن أبي طالب رضي الله عنه
sourceEn: ‘Alî ibn Abî Tâlib (may Allah be pleased with him)

textAr: إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُحِبُّ الْعَبْدَ الَّذِي يَغْضُضُ بَصَرَهُ
textFr: Allah aime le serviteur qui abaisse son regard.
textEn: Allah loves the servant who lowers his gaze.
sourceEn: Al-Hasan al-Basrî (may Allah have mercy on him)

textAr: لَا تَكُونُوا مِمَّنْ يَخْشَى النَّاسَ فِي اللَّهِ
textFr: Ne soyez pas de ceux qui craignent les gens au sujet d'Allah.
textEn: Do not be among those who fear people regarding Allah.
sourceEn: Sufyân ath-Thawrî (may Allah have mercy on him)

textAr: مَنْ تَرَكَ الْفُضُولَ نَالَ الْوَرَعَ
textFr: Celui qui abandonne les choses superflues obtient la scrupulosité.
textEn: Whoever abandons superfluous things attains scrupulousness.
sourceAr: عبد الله بن مسعود رضي الله عنه
sourceEn: ‘Abd Allâh ibn Mas‘ûd (may Allah be pleased with him)

textAr: إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُحِبُّ الْعَبْدَ الَّذِي يَذْكُرُهُ فِي الْخَلَاءِ
textFr: Allah aime le serviteur qui Le mentionne dans l'isolement.
textEn: Allah loves the servant who mentions Him in seclusion.
sourceAr: عمر بن الخطاب رضي الله عنه
sourceEn: ‘Umar ibn al-Khattâb (may Allah be pleased with him)

textAr: لَا تَكُنْ مِمَّنْ يَشْتَهِي الطَّعَامَ وَيَنْسَى الذِّكْرَ
textFr: Ne sois pas de ceux qui désirent la nourriture et oublient le rappel.
textEn: Do not be among those who desire food and forget the remembrance.
sourceAr: علي بن أبي طالب رضي الله عنه
sourceEn: ‘Alî ibn Abî Tâlib (may Allah be pleased with him)

textAr: مَنْ صَبَرَ عَلَى الْعُبُودِيَّةِ نَالَ الْحُرِّيَّةَ
textFr: Celui qui endure l'adoration obtient la liberté.
textEn: Whoever endures worship attains freedom.
sourceEn: Al-Hasan al-Basrî (may Allah have mercy on him)

textAr: إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُحِبُّ الْعَبْدَ الَّذِي يَحْلُمُ عَلَى النَّاسِ
textFr: Allah aime le serviteur qui est clément envers les gens.
textEn: Allah loves the servant who is clement towards people.
sourceEn: Sufyân ath-Thawrî (may Allah have mercy on him)

textAr: لَا تَكُونُوا مِمَّنْ يَغْضَبُ كَثِيرًا فَيَخْسَرُ دِينَهُ
textFr: Ne soyez pas de ceux qui se mettent souvent en colère, car ils perdent leur religion.
textEn: Do not be among those who get angry often, for they lose their religion.
sourceAr: عبد الله بن مسعود رضي الله عنه
sourceEn: ‘Abd Allâh ibn Mas‘ûd (may Allah be pleased with him)

textAr: مَنْ تَرَكَ الْحَسَدَ نَالَ الرَّاحَةَ
textFr: Celui qui abandonne l'envie obtient le repos.
textEn: Whoever abandons envy attains rest.
sourceAr: عمر بن الخطاب رضي الله عنه
sourceEn: ‘Umar ibn al-Khattâb (may Allah be pleased with him)

textAr: إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُحِبُّ الْعَبْدَ الَّذِي يُؤْثِرُ النَّاسَ عَلَى نَفْسِهِ
textFr: Allah aime le serviteur qui préfère les autres à lui-même.
textEn: Allah loves the servant who prefers others over himself.
sourceAr: علي بن أبي طالب رضي الله عنه
sourceEn: ‘Alî ibn Abî Tâlib (may Allah be pleased with him)

textAr: لَا تَكُنْ مِمَّنْ يَشْكُو الْفَقْرَ وَيَتْرُكُ الْعَمَلَ
textFr: Ne sois pas de ceux qui se plaignent de la pauvreté et abandonnent le travail.
textEn: Do not be among those who complain about poverty and abandon work.
sourceEn: Al-Hasan al-Basrî (may Allah have mercy on him)

textAr: مَنْ صَبَرَ عَلَى الْفَقْرِ نَالَ الْغِنَى
textFr: Celui qui endure la pauvreté obtient la richesse.
textEn: Whoever endures poverty attains wealth.
sourceEn: Sufyân ath-Thawrî (may Allah have mercy on him)

textAr: إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُحِبُّ الْعَبْدَ الَّذِي يَصْدُقُ فِي الْحَدِيثِ
textFr: Allah aime le serviteur qui est véridique dans son propos.
textEn: Allah loves the servant who is truthful in his speech.
sourceAr: عبد الله بن مسعود رضي الله عنه
sourceEn: ‘Abd Allâh ibn Mas‘ûd (may Allah be pleased with him)

textAr: لَا تَكُونُوا مِمَّنْ يَأْكُلُ كَثِيرًا فَيَثْقُلُ عَنِ الْعِبَادَةِ
textFr: Ne soyez pas de ceux qui mangent beaucoup, car cela les alourdit dans l'adoration.
textEn: Do not be among those who eat a lot, for it weighs them down in worship.
sourceAr: عمر بن الخطاب رضي الله عنه
sourceEn: ‘Umar ibn al-Khattâb (may Allah be pleased with him)

textAr: مَنْ تَرَكَ الشَّهَوَاتِ نَالَ الْعِبَادَةَ
textFr: Celui qui abandonne les passions obtient l'adoration.
textEn: Whoever abandons desires attains worship.
sourceAr: علي بن أبي طالب رضي الله عنه
sourceEn: ‘Alî ibn Abî Tâlib (may Allah be pleased with him)

textAr: إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُحِبُّ الْعَبْدَ الَّذِي يُحْسِنُ الْوُضُوءَ
textFr: Allah aime le serviteur qui fait bien ses ablutions.
textEn: Allah loves the servant who performs ablution well.
sourceEn: Al-Hasan al-Basrî (may Allah have mercy on him)

textAr: لَا تَكُنْ مِمَّنْ يَضْحَكُ فِي الْمَقَابِرِ
textFr: Ne sois pas de ceux qui rient dans les cimetières.
textEn: Do not be among those who laugh in the cemeteries.
sourceEn: Sufyân ath-Thawrî (may Allah have mercy on him)

textAr: مَنْ صَبَرَ عَلَى الْحِفْظِ نَالَ الْفَهْمَ
textFr: Celui qui endure la mémorisation obtient la compréhension.
textEn: Whoever endures memorization attains understanding.
sourceAr: عبد الله بن مسعود رضي الله عنه
sourceEn: ‘Abd Allâh ibn Mas‘ûd (may Allah be pleased with him)

textAr: إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُحِبُّ الْعَبْدَ الَّذِي يَحْفَظُ الْقُرْآنَ
textFr: Allah aime le serviteur qui mémorise le Coran.
textEn: Allah loves the servant who memorizes the Quran.
sourceAr: عمر بن الخطاب رضي الله عنه
sourceEn: ‘Umar ibn al-Khattâb (may Allah be pleased with him)

textAr: لَا تَكُونُوا مِمَّنْ يَنْسَى الْقُرْآنَ
textFr: Ne soyez pas de ceux qui oublient le Coran.
textEn: Do not be among those who forget the Quran.
sourceAr: علي بن أبي طالب رضي الله عنه
sourceEn: ‘Alî ibn Abî Tâlib (may Allah be pleased with him)

textAr: مَنْ تَرَكَ الدُّنْيَا رَبِحَ الْآخِرَةَ
textFr: Celui qui abandonne ce monde gagne l'au-delà.
textEn: Whoever abandons this world gains the Hereafter.
sourceEn: Al-Hasan al-Basrî (may Allah have mercy on him)

textAr: إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُحِبُّ الْعَبْدَ الَّذِي يَصْبِرُ عَلَى الصَّلَاةِ
textFr: Allah aime le serviteur qui endure la prière.
textEn: Allah loves the servant who endures prayer.
sourceEn: Sufyân ath-Thawrî (may Allah have mercy on him)

textAr: لَا تَكُنْ مِمَّنْ يَخْشَى الْعُزْلَةَ
textFr: Ne sois pas de ceux qui craignent la solitude.
textEn: Do not be among those who fear solitude.
sourceAr: عبد الله بن مسعود رضي الله عنه
sourceEn: ‘Abd Allâh ibn Mas‘ûd (may Allah be pleased with him)

textAr: مَنْ صَبَرَ عَلَى الطَّاعَةِ نَالَ الْقُرْبَةَ
textFr: Celui qui endure l'obéissance obtient la proximité.
textEn: Whoever endures obedience attains closeness.
sourceAr: عمر بن الخطاب رضي الله عنه
sourceEn: ‘Umar ibn al-Khattâb (may Allah be pleased with him)

textAr: إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُحِبُّ الْعَبْدَ الَّذِي يَذْكُرُهُ فِي الْقُرْآنِ
textFr: Allah aime le serviteur qui Le mentionne dans le Coran.
textEn: Allah loves the servant who mentions Him in the Quran.
sourceAr: علي بن أبي طالب رضي الله عنه
sourceEn: ‘Alî ibn Abî Tâlib (may Allah be pleased with him)

textAr: لَا تَكُونُوا مِمَّنْ يَكْسَلُ عَنِ الصَّلَاةِ
textFr: Ne soyez pas de ceux qui sont paresseux pour la prière.
textEn: Do not be among those who are lazy for prayer.
sourceEn: Al-Hasan al-Basrî (may Allah have mercy on him)

textAr: مَنْ تَرَكَ الْمَعْصِيَةَ نَالَ الْمَغْفِرَةَ
textFr: Celui qui abandonne la désobéissance obtient le pardon.
textEn: Whoever abandons disobedience attains forgiveness.
sourceEn: Sufyân ath-Thawrî (may Allah have mercy on him)

textAr: إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُحِبُّ الْعَبْدَ الَّذِي يَخْشَاهُ فِي الْعَلَانِيَةِ
textFr: Allah aime le serviteur qui Le craint en public.
textEn: Allah loves the servant who fears Him in public.
sourceAr: عبد الله بن مسعود رضي الله عنه
sourceEn: ‘Abd Allâh ibn Mas‘ûd (may Allah be pleased with him)

textAr: لَا تَكُنْ مِمَّنْ يَذْكُرُ اللَّهَ قَلِيلًا
textFr: Ne sois pas de ceux qui mentionnent Allah rarement.
textEn: Do not be among those who mention Allah rarely.
sourceAr: عمر بن الخطاب رضي الله عنه
sourceEn: ‘Umar ibn al-Khattâb (may Allah be pleased with him)

textAr: مَنْ صَبَرَ عَلَى الدُّنْيَا نَالَ الْآخِرَةَ
textFr: Celui qui endure ce monde obtient l'au-delà.
textEn: Whoever endures this world attains the Hereafter.
sourceAr: علي بن أبي طالب رضي الله عنه
sourceEn: ‘Alî ibn Abî Tâlib (may Allah be pleased with him)

textAr: إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُحِبُّ الْعَبْدَ الَّذِي يَتَعَلَّمُ الْعِلْمَ
textFr: Allah aime le serviteur qui apprend la science.
textEn: Allah loves the servant who learns knowledge.
sourceEn: Al-Hasan al-Basrî (may Allah have mercy on him)

textAr: لَا تَكُونُوا مِمَّنْ يَأْخُذُ الْعِلْمَ لِلرِّيَاءِ
textFr: Ne soyez pas de ceux qui apprennent la science pour l'ostentation.
textEn: Do not be among those who learn knowledge for showing off.
sourceEn: Sufyân ath-Thawrî (may Allah have mercy on him)

textAr: رَبَّنَا لَا تُزِغْ قُلُوبَنَا بَعْدَ إِذْ هَدَيْتَنَا
textFr: Seigneur, ne fais pas dévier nos cœurs après nous avoir guidés.
textEn: Our Lord, do not let our hearts deviate after You have guided us.
sourceEn: Quran 3:8 (Supplication of the Salaf)
